19:59.ar: ۞فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا
19:59.wbw: Then succeeded after them after them successors who neglected the prayer and they followed the lusts so soon they will meet evil
19:59.tr: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

21:43.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞ تَمۡنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَاۚ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُونَ
21:43.wbw: Or have they gods (to) defend them from Us? Not they are able (to) help themselves and not they from Us can be protected
21:43.tr: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.

29:10.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِيَ فِي ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصۡرٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡۚ أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
29:10.wbw: And of the people (is he) who says "We believe in Allah" But when he is harmed in (the Way of) Allah he considers (the) trial (of) the people as (the) punishment (of) Allah But if comes victory from your Lord surely they say "Indeed, we were with you" Is not Allah most knowing of what (is) in (the) breasts (of) the worlds?
29:10.tr: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?

7:112.wbw: They (will) bring to you [with] every magician" learned"
7:112.tr: Who will bring you every learned magician."

26:212.wbw: Indeed they from the hearing (are) surely banished
26:212.tr: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

21:45.ar: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلۡوَحۡيِۚ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
21:45.wbw: Say "Only I warn you by the revelation" But not hear the deaf the call when when they are warned
21:45.tr: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

14:39.ar: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى ٱلۡكِبَرِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
14:39.wbw: All the Praise (is) for Allah the One Who has granted me in the old age Ismail and Ishaq Indeed my Lord (is) All-Hearer (of) the prayer
14:39.tr: Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.

41:51.ar: وَإِذَآ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ أَعۡرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٖ
41:51.wbw: And when We bestow favor upon man he turns away and distances himself and distances himself but when touches him the evil then (he is) full (of) supplication lengthy
41:51.tr: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.

79:39.wbw: Then indeed the Hell-Fire it (is) the refuge
79:39.tr: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

51:56.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
51:56.wbw: And not I have created the jinn and the mankind except that they worship Me
51:56.tr: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

17:68.ar: أَفَأَمِنتُمۡ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلۡبَرِّ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُواْ لَكُمۡ وَكِيلًا
17:68.wbw: Do you then feel secure that (not) He will cause to swallow you side (of) the land or send against you a storm of stones? Then not you will find for you a guardian?
17:68.tr: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.

82:13.wbw: Indeed the righteous (will be) surely in bliss
82:13.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

38:27.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
38:27.wbw: And not We created the heaven and the earth and whatever (is) between them without purpose That (is the) assumption (of) those who disbelieve So woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire
38:27.tr: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

4:118.ar: لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُۘ وَقَالَ لَأَتَّخِذَنَّ مِنۡ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيبٗا مَّفۡرُوضٗا
4:118.wbw: He was cursed by Allah and he said "I will surely take from your slaves a portion appointed"
4:118.tr: Whom Allah has cursed. For he had said, "I will surely take from among Your servants a specific portion.

2:202.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ نَصِيبٞ مِّمَّا كَسَبُواْۚ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
2:202.wbw: Those - for them (is) a share of what they earned and Allah (is) swift (in taking) account
2:202.tr: Those will have a share of what they have earned, and Allah is swift in account.

2:18.ar: صُمُّۢ بُكۡمٌ عُمۡيٞ فَهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
2:18.wbw: Deaf dumb blind so they not [they] will not return
2:18.tr: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].

16:67.ar: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنۡهُ سَكَرٗا وَرِزۡقًا حَسَنًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
16:67.wbw: And from fruits the date-palm and the grapes you take from it intoxicant and a provision good Indeed in that (is) surely a Sign for a people who use reason
16:67.tr: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.

18:94.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِنَّ يَأۡجُوجَ وَمَأۡجُوجَ مُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدّٗا
18:94.wbw: They said "O Dhul-qarnain! "O Dhul-qarnain! Indeed Yajuj and Majuj (are) corrupters in the land So may we make for you an expenditure [on] that you make between us and between them a barrier?"
18:94.tr: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"

26:183.ar: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
26:183.wbw: And (do) not deprive people (of) their things and (do) not commit evil in the earth spreading corruption
26:183.tr: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

5:2.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُحِلُّواْ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا ٱلشَّهۡرَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ وَلَا ٱلۡهَدۡيَ وَلَا ٱلۡقَلَٰٓئِدَ وَلَآ ءَآمِّينَ ٱلۡبَيۡتَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَرِضۡوَٰنٗاۚ وَإِذَا حَلَلۡتُمۡ فَٱصۡطَادُواْۚ وَلَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوۡمٍ أَن صَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ أَن تَعۡتَدُواْۘ وَتَعَاوَنُواْ عَلَى ٱلۡبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقۡوَىٰۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُواْ عَلَى ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٰنِۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
5:2.wbw: O you who believe! (Do) not violate (the) rites (of) Allah and not the month the sacred and not the sacrificial animals and not the garlanded and not (those) coming (to) the House the Sacred seeking Bounty of their Lord and good pleasure And when you come out of Ihram then (you may) hunt And let not incite you (the) hatred (for) a people as they stopped you from Al-Masjid Al-Haraam that you commit transgression And help one another in [the] righteousness and [the] piety but (do) not help one another in [the] sin and [the] transgression And fear Allah indeed Allah (is) severe (in) [the] punishment
5:2.tr: O you who have believed, do not violate the rites of Allah or [the sanctity of] the sacred month or [neglect the marking of] the sacrificial animals and garlanding [them] or [violate the safety of] those coming to the Sacred House seeking bounty from their Lord and [His] approval. But when you come out of ihram, then [you may] hunt. And do not let the hatred of a people for having obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram lead you to transgress. And cooperate in righteousness and piety, but do not cooperate in sin and aggression. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.

26:193.wbw: Has brought it down Has brought it down the Spirit [the] Trustworthy
26:193.tr: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down

42:52.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
42:52.wbw: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration by Our Command Not did you know what the Book (is) and not the faith But We have made it a light We guide with it whom We will of Our slaves And indeed you surely guide to (the) path straight
42:52.tr: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -

17:85.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّي وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
17:85.wbw: And they ask you concerning the soul Say "The soul (is) of (the) affair (of) my Lord And not you have been given of the knowledge except a little"
17:85.tr: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little."

36:31.ar: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
36:31.wbw: Do not they see how many We destroyed before them of the generations? That they to them will not return will not return
36:31.tr: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

22:33.ar: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡعَتِيقِ
22:33.wbw: For you therein (are) benefits for a term appointed; then their place of sacrifice (is) at the House the Ancient
22:33.tr: For you the animals marked for sacrifice are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.

6:2.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٖ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلٗاۖ وَأَجَلٞ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥۖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمۡ تَمۡتَرُونَ
6:2.wbw: He (is) the One Who created you from clay then He decreed a term - and a term specified with Him yet you doubt
6:2.tr: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to Him; then [still] you are in dispute.

48:8.wbw: Indeed We [We] have sent you (as) a witness and (as) a bearer of glad tidings and (as) a warner
48:8.tr: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

69:49.wbw: And indeed We surely know that among you (are) deniers
69:49.tr: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

5:56.ar: وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فَإِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
5:56.wbw: And whoever takes as an ally Allah and His Messenger and those who believe then indeed (the) party (of) Allah they (are) the victorious
5:56.tr: And whoever is an ally of Allah and His Messenger and those who have believed - indeed, the party of Allah - they will be the predominant.

38:11.ar: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
38:11.wbw: Soldiers there there (they will be) defeated among the companies
38:11.tr: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

33:22.ar: وَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابَ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَصَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ وَمَا زَادَهُمۡ إِلَّآ إِيمَٰنٗا وَتَسۡلِيمٗا
33:22.wbw: And when saw the believers the confederates they said "This (is) what Allah promised us Allah promised us and His Messenger and Allah spoke the truth and Allah spoke the truth and His Messenger And not it increased them except (in) faith and submission
33:22.tr: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.

36:79.ar: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
36:79.wbw: Say "He will give them life Who produced them (the) first time; and He (is) of every creation All-Knower"
36:79.tr: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

28:54.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡتَوۡنَ أَجۡرَهُم مَّرَّتَيۡنِ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيَدۡرَءُونَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
28:54.wbw: Those will be given their reward twice because they are patient and they repel with good - the evil and from what We have provided them they spend
28:54.tr: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.

41:43.ar: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبۡلِكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغۡفِرَةٖ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
41:43.wbw: Not is said to you except what was said was said to the Messengers before you before you Indeed your Lord (is) Possessor (of) forgiveness and Possessor (of) penalty painful
41:43.tr: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

40:22.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِيّٞ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
40:22.wbw: That (was) because [they] used to come to them used to come to them their Messengers with clear proofs but they disbelieved So Allah seized them So Allah seized them Indeed, He (is) All-Strong severe (in) punishment
40:22.tr: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allah seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.

56:93.tr: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

40:72.ar: فِي ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي ٱلنَّارِ يُسۡجَرُونَ
40:72.wbw: In the boiling water; then in the Fire they will be burned
40:72.tr: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].

3:108.ar: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلۡمٗا لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
3:108.wbw: These (are the) Verses (of) Allah We recite them to you in truth And not Allah wants injustice to the worlds
3:108.tr: These are the verses of Allah. We recite them to you, [O Muhammad], in truth; and Allah wants no injustice to the worlds.

3:48.wbw: And He will teach him the Book and [the] wisdom and the Taurat and the Injeel
3:48.tr: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel

18:69.ar: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرٗا وَلَآ أَعۡصِي لَكَ أَمۡرٗا
18:69.wbw: He said "You will find me if Allah wills Allah wills patient and not I will disobey your order"
18:69.tr: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."

3:142.ar: أَمۡ حَسِبۡتُمۡ أَن تَدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعۡلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَيَعۡلَمَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
3:142.wbw: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while has not yet made evident Allah those who strove hard among you and made evident the steadfast
3:142.tr: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while Allah has not yet made evident those of you who fight in His cause and made evident those who are steadfast?

35:43.ar: ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَكۡرَ ٱلسَّيِّيِٕۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلۡمَكۡرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهۡلِهِۦۚ فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗاۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحۡوِيلًا
35:43.wbw: (Due to) arrogance in the land and plotting (of) the evil; but not encompasses the plot (of) the evil except its own people Then do they wait except (the) way (of) the former (people)? But never you will find in (the) way (of) Allah any change and never you will find in (the) way (of) Allah any alteration
35:43.tr: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change, and you will never find in the way of Allah any alteration.

71:22.wbw: And they have planned a plan great
71:22.tr: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.

4:73.ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَصَٰبَكُمۡ فَضۡلٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لَيَقُولَنَّ كَأَن لَّمۡ تَكُنۢ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ مَوَدَّةٞ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ مَعَهُمۡ فَأَفُوزَ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمٗا
4:73.wbw: And if befalls you bounty from Allah he would surely say as if (had) not there been between you and between him any affection "Oh! I wish I had been with them then I would have attained a success great"
4:73.tr: But if bounty comes to you from Allah, he will surely say, as if there had never been between you and him any affection. "Oh, I wish I had been with them so I could have attained a great attainment."

3:3.ar: نَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ
3:3.wbw: He revealed to you the Book in [the] truth confirming that which (was) before it and He revealed the Taurat and the Injeel
3:3.tr: He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.

15:81.wbw: And We gave them Our Signs but they were from them turning away
15:81.tr: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

9:76.ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦ بَخِلُواْ بِهِۦ وَتَوَلَّواْ وَّهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
9:76.wbw: But when He gave them of His Bounty they became stingy with it and turned away while they (were) averse
9:76.tr: But when he gave them from His bounty, they were stingy with it and turned away while they refused.

56:85.ar: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ
56:85.wbw: And We (are) nearer to him than you but you (do) not see you (do) not see
56:85.tr: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

2:180.ar: كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ إِن تَرَكَ خَيۡرًا ٱلۡوَصِيَّةُ لِلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ وَٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
2:180.wbw: Prescribed for you when approaches any of you [the] death if he leaves good (making) the will for the parents and the near relatives with due fairness a duty on the righteous ones
2:180.tr: Prescribed for you when death approaches [any] one of you if he leaves wealth [is that he should make] a bequest for the parents and near relatives according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous.

18:7.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ زِينَةٗ لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗا
18:7.wbw: Indeed We We have made what (is) on the earth adornment for it that We may test [them] which of them (is) best (in) deed
18:7.tr: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

105:3.wbw: And He sent against them birds (in) flocks
105:3.tr: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

21:84.ar: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرّٖۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
21:84.wbw: So We responded to him and We removed what (was) on him of (the) adversity And We gave him his family and (the) like thereof with them (as) Mercy from Ourselves from Ourselves and a reminder for the worshippers
21:84.tr: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah].

23:75.ar: ۞وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرّٖ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
23:75.wbw: And if We had mercy on them and We removed what (was) on them of (the) hardship surely they would persist in their transgression wandering blindly
23:75.tr: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

10:12.ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ٱلضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنۢبِهِۦٓ أَوۡ قَاعِدًا أَوۡ قَآئِمٗا فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُ ضُرَّهُۥ مَرَّ كَأَن لَّمۡ يَدۡعُنَآ إِلَىٰ ضُرّٖ مَّسَّهُۥۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
10:12.wbw: And when touches the man the affliction he calls Us (lying) on his side or sitting or standing But when We remove from him his affliction he passes on as if he (had) not called Us for (the) affliction (that) touched him Thus (it) is made fair seeming to the extravagant what they used (to) do
10:12.tr: And when affliction touches man, he calls upon Us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when We remove from him his affliction, he continues [in disobedience] as if he had never called upon Us to [remove] an affliction that touched him. Thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing

3:163.ar: هُمۡ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ
3:163.wbw: They (are in varying) degrees near Allah and Allah (is) All-Seer of what they do
3:163.tr: They are [varying] degrees in the sight of Allah, and Allah is Seeing of whatever they do.

8:4.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ حَقّٗاۚ لَّهُمۡ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَمَغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ
8:4.wbw: Those - they are the believers (in) truth For them (are) ranks with their Lord and forgiveness and a provision noble
8:4.tr: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.

47:11.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
47:11.wbw: That (is) because Allah (is the) Protector (of) those who believe and because the disbelievers - (there is) no protector for them
47:11.tr: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

44:41.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
44:41.wbw: (The) Day not will avail a relation for a relation anything and not they will be helped
44:41.tr: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

69:12.ar: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٞ وَٰعِيَةٞ
69:12.wbw: That We might make it for you a reminder and would be conscious of it an ear conscious
69:12.tr: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

4:124.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ نَقِيرٗا
4:124.wbw: And whoever does [of] [the] righteous deeds from (the) male or female and he (is) a believer then those will enter Paradise and not they will be wronged (even as much as) the speck on a date-seed
4:124.tr: And whoever does righteous deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged, [even as much as] the speck on a date seed.

43:37.ar: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
43:37.wbw: And indeed they surely turn them away from the Path and they think that they (are) guided
43:37.tr: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

2:2.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَۛ فِيهِۛ هُدٗى لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
2:2.wbw: That (is) the Book no doubt in it a Guidance for the God-conscious
2:2.tr: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

3:104.ar: وَلۡتَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أُمَّةٞ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
3:104.wbw: And let there be among you [a] people inviting to the good [and] enjoining the right and forbidding from the wrong and those - they (are) the successful ones
3:104.tr: And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful.

29:29.ar: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأۡتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
29:29.wbw: Indeed you approach the men and you cut off the road and commit in your meetings evil?" And not was (the) answer (of) his people except that they said "Bring upon us (the) punishment (of) Allah if you are of the truthful"
29:29.tr: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allah, if you should be of the truthful."

29:60.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٖ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
29:60.wbw: And how many of a creature (does) not carry its provision Allah provides (for) it and (for) you And He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower
29:60.tr: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

12:27.ar: وَإِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٖ فَكَذَبَتۡ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
12:27.wbw: But if [is] his shirt (is) torn from (the) back then she has lied and he (is) of the truthful"
12:27.tr: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful."

13:9.wbw: Knower (of) the unseen and the witnessed the Most Great the Most High
13:9.tr: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

19:4.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبٗا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيّٗا
19:4.wbw: He said "My Lord! Indeed, [I] (have) weakened my bones my bones and flared (my) head (with) white and not I have been in (my) supplication (to) You my Lord unblessed
19:4.tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.

27:17.ar: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
27:17.wbw: And were gathered for Sulaiman his hosts of jinn and the men and the birds and they (were) set in rows
27:17.tr: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.

55:74.ar: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
55:74.wbw: Not has touched them any man before them and not any jinn
55:74.tr: Untouched before them by man or jinni -

19:68.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيّٗا
19:68.wbw: So by your Lord surely We will gather them and the devils then surely We will bring them around Hell bent (on) knees
19:68.tr: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.

70:38.ar: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٖ
70:38.wbw: Does long every person among them that he enters a Garden (of) Delight?
70:38.tr: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

56:89.wbw: Then rest and bounty and a Garden (of) Pleasure
56:89.tr: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

10:26.ar: ۞لِّلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ وَزِيَادَةٞۖ وَلَا يَرۡهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمۡ قَتَرٞ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
10:26.wbw: For those who do good (is) the best and more And not (will) cover their faces dust and not humiliation Those (are the) companions (of) Paradise they in it (will) abide forever
10:26.tr: For them who have done good is the best [reward] and extra. No darkness will cover their faces, nor humiliation. Those are companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally

21:101.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُونَ
21:101.wbw: Indeed those has gone forth for them from Us the good those from it (will be) removed far
21:101.tr: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.

7:180.ar: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ فَٱدۡعُوهُ بِهَاۖ وَذَرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلۡحِدُونَ فِيٓ أَسۡمَٰٓئِهِۦۚ سَيُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
7:180.wbw: And for Allah (are) the names - the most beautiful so invoke Him by them And leave those who deviate concerning His names They will be recompensed for what they used to do
7:180.tr: And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.

16:78.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَخۡرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
16:78.wbw: And Allah brought you forth from the wombs (of) your mothers not knowing anything and made for you the hearing and the sight and the hearts so that you may give thanks
16:78.tr: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.

56:53.wbw: Then will fill with it the bellies
56:53.tr: And filling with it your bellies

43:16.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتٖ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ
43:16.wbw: Or has He taken of what He has created daughters and He has chosen (for) you sons
43:16.tr: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

38:30.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38:30.wbw: And We gave to Dawood Sulaiman an excellent slave Indeed he was one who repeatedly turned
38:30.tr: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

3:39.ar: فَنَادَتۡهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٞ يُصَلِّي فِي ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحۡيَىٰ مُصَدِّقَۢا بِكَلِمَةٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدٗا وَحَصُورٗا وَنَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
3:39.wbw: Then called him the Angels when he (was) standing - praying in the prayer chamber "Indeed Allah gives you glad tidings of Yahya confirming [of] a Word from Allah and a noble and chaste and a Prophet among the righteous
3:39.tr: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."

17:32.ar: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةٗ وَسَآءَ سَبِيلٗا
17:32.wbw: And (do) not go near adultery Indeed it is an immorality and (an) evil way
17:32.tr: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.

42:37.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُواْ هُمۡ يَغۡفِرُونَ
42:37.wbw: And those who avoid (the) greater sins and the immoralities and when and when they are angry they forgive
42:37.tr: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

6:150.ar: قُلۡ هَلُمَّ شُهَدَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشۡهَدُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَ هَٰذَاۖ فَإِن شَهِدُواْ فَلَا تَشۡهَدۡ مَعَهُمۡۚ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَهُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يَعۡدِلُونَ
6:150.wbw: Say "Bring forward your witnesses those who testify that Allah prohibited this" Then if they testify then (do) not testify with them And (do) not follow (the) desires (of) those who denied Our Signs and those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter while they with their Lord set up equals
6:150.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "Bring forward your witnesses who will testify that Allah has prohibited this." And if they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the desires of those who deny Our verses and those who do not believe in the Hereafter, while they equate [others] with their Lord.

21:72.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ نَافِلَةٗۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
21:72.wbw: And We bestowed on him Ishaq and Yaqub (in) addition and all We made righteous
21:72.tr: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

9:109.ar: أَفَمَنۡ أَسَّسَ بُنۡيَٰنَهُۥ عَلَىٰ تَقۡوَىٰ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنٍ خَيۡرٌ أَم مَّنۡ أَسَّسَ بُنۡيَٰنَهُۥ عَلَىٰ شَفَا جُرُفٍ هَارٖ فَٱنۡهَارَ بِهِۦ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
9:109.wbw: Then is (one) who founded his building on righteousness from Allah and (His) pleasure better or (one) who founded his building on edge (of) a cliff (about to) collapse so it collapsed with him in (the) Fire (of) Hell And Allah (does) not guide the wrongdoing people the wrongdoing people
9:109.tr: Then is one who laid the foundation of his building on righteousness [with fear] from Allah and [seeking] His approval better or one who laid the foundation of his building on the edge of a bank about to collapse, so it collapsed with him into the fire of Hell? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

22:32.ar: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَن يُعَظِّمۡ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقۡوَى ٱلۡقُلُوبِ
22:32.wbw: That and whoever honors (the) Symbols (of) Allah then indeed it (is) from (the) piety (of) the hearts
22:32.tr: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.

14:8.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِن تَكۡفُرُوٓاْ أَنتُمۡ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ
14:8.wbw: And said Musa "If you disbelieve you and whoever (is) in the earth all then indeed Allah certainly (is) Free of need Praiseworthy"
14:8.tr: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy."

37:16.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
37:16.wbw: Is it when we are dead and have become dust and bones shall we then be certainly resurrected
37:16.tr: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

12:101.ar: ۞رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِي مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّۦ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
12:101.wbw: My Lord indeed you have given me of the sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of the events Creator (of) the heavens and the earth You (are) my Protector in the world and the Hereafter Cause me to die (as) a Muslim and join me with the righteous"
12:101.tr: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

53:11.wbw: Not lied the heart what it saw
53:11.tr: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

67:23.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
67:23.wbw: Say "He (is) the One Who produced you and made for you the hearing and the vision and the feelings Little (is) what you give thanks"
67:23.tr: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

15:13.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
15:13.wbw: Not they believe in it and verily have passed the way(s) (of) the former (people)
15:13.tr: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

4:8.ar: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ ٱلۡقِسۡمَةَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينُ فَٱرۡزُقُوهُم مِّنۡهُ وَقُولُواْ لَهُمۡ قَوۡلٗا مَّعۡرُوفٗا
4:8.wbw: And when present (at) the (time of) division (of) the relatives and the orphans and the poor then provide them from it and speak to them words (of) kindness
4:8.tr: And when [other] relatives and orphans and the needy are present at the [time of] division, then provide for them [something] out of the estate and speak to them words of appropriate kindness.

9:113.ar: مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن يَسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ لِلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَلَوۡ كَانُوٓاْ أُوْلِي قُرۡبَىٰ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
9:113.wbw: Not (it) is for the Prophet and those who believe that they ask forgiveness for the polytheists even though they be near of kin near of kin after after [what] has become clear to them that they (are the) companions (of) the Hellfire
9:113.tr: It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire.

53:52.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
53:52.wbw: And (the) people (of) Nuh before before Indeed, they they were they were more unjust and more rebellious
53:52.tr: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

10:17.ar: فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
10:17.wbw: So who (is) more wrong than he who invents against Allah a lie or denies His Signs? Indeed not will succeed the criminals
10:17.tr: So who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah or denies His signs? Indeed, the criminals will not succeed

40:54.wbw: A guide and a reminder for those (of) understanding
40:54.tr: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.

38:17.ar: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38:17.wbw: Be patient over what they say and remember Our slave Dawood the possessor of strength the possessor of strength Indeed, he (was) repeatedly turning
38:17.tr: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].

15:46.tr: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

27:89.ar: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٖ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
27:89.wbw: Whoever comes with the good then for him (will be) better than it and they from (the) terror (of) that Day (will be) safe
27:89.tr: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.

8:69.ar: فَكُلُواْ مِمَّا غَنِمۡتُمۡ حَلَٰلٗا طَيِّبٗاۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
8:69.wbw: So eat from what you got as war booty - lawful (and) good and fear Allah Indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
8:69.tr: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

19:6.ar: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيّٗا
19:6.wbw: Who will inherit me and inherit from (the) family (of) Yaqub And make him my Lord pleasing"
19:6.tr: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."

84:12.wbw: And he will burn (in) a Blaze
84:12.tr: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

25:11.ar: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلسَّاعَةِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
25:11.wbw: Nay they deny the Hour and We have prepared for (those) who deny the Hour a Blazing Fire
25:11.tr: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

55:7.wbw: And the heaven He raised it and He has set up the balance
55:7.tr: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

11:85.ar: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
11:85.wbw: And O my people! Give full measure and weight in justice and (do) not deprive the people (of) their things and (do) not act wickedly in the earth spreading corruption
11:85.tr: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.

2:135.ar: وَقَالُواْ كُونُواْ هُودًا أَوۡ نَصَٰرَىٰ تَهۡتَدُواْۗ قُلۡ بَلۡ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِـۧمَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
2:135.wbw: And they said "Be Jews or Christians (then) you will be guided" Say "Nay (the) religion (of) Ibrahim (the) upright; and not he was of those who associated partners (with Allah)"
2:135.tr: They say, "Be Jews or Christians [so] you will be guided." Say, "Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists."

40:34.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبۡلُ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ رَسُولٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ مُّرۡتَابٌ
40:34.wbw: And indeed came to you Yusuf before before with clear proofs but not you ceased in doubt about what he brought to you [with it] until when he died you said "Never will Allah raise will Allah raise after him after him a Messenger" Thus Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray who [he] (is) a transgressor a doubter"
40:34.tr: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allah send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allah leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."

43:5.ar: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّسۡرِفِينَ
43:5.wbw: Then should We take away from you the Reminder disregarding (you) because you (are) a people transgressing?
43:5.tr: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

44:9.tr: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

70:5.wbw: So be patient a patience good
70:5.tr: So be patient with gracious patience.

9:91.ar: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلضُّعَفَآءِ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرۡضَىٰ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ مَا يُنفِقُونَ حَرَجٌ إِذَا نَصَحُواْ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ مَا عَلَى ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ مِن سَبِيلٖۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
9:91.wbw: Not on the weak and not on the sick and not on those who not they find what they (can) spend any blame if they (are) sincere to Allah and His Messenger Not (is) on the good-doers [of] any way (for blame) And Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
9:91.tr: There is not upon the weak or upon the ill or upon those who do not find anything to spend any discomfort when they are sincere to Allah and His Messenger. There is not upon the doers of good any cause [for blame]. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

33:37.ar: وَإِذۡ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِيٓ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَمۡسِكۡ عَلَيۡكَ زَوۡجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخۡفِي فِي نَفۡسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبۡدِيهِ وَتَخۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخۡشَىٰهُۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيۡدٞ مِّنۡهَا وَطَرٗا زَوَّجۡنَٰكَهَا لِكَيۡ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ حَرَجٞ فِيٓ أَزۡوَٰجِ أَدۡعِيَآئِهِمۡ إِذَا قَضَوۡاْ مِنۡهُنَّ وَطَرٗاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفۡعُولٗا
33:37.wbw: And when you said to the one Allah bestowed favor Allah bestowed favor on him and you bestowed favor on him "Keep to yourself your wife and fear Allah" But you concealed within yourself what Allah (was to) disclose And you fear the people while Allah has more right that you (should) fear Him So when ended Zaid from her necessary (formalities) We married her to you so that not there be on the believers any discomfort concerning the wives (of) their adopted sons when they have ended from them necessary (formalities) And is (the) Command (of) Allah accomplished
33:37.tr: And [remember, O Muhammad], when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allah," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allah has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command of Allah accomplished.

79:45.wbw: Only you (are) a warner (for him) who fears it
79:45.tr: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

3:95.ar: قُلۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُۗ فَٱتَّبِعُواْ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
3:95.wbw: Say (has) spoken the truth Allah then follow (the) religion (of) Ibrahim (the) upright and not he was of the polytheists
3:95.tr: Say, "Allah has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists."

25:22.ar: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشۡرَىٰ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا
25:22.wbw: (The) Day they see the Angels no glad tidings (will be) that Day for the criminals and they will say "A partition forbidden"
25:22.tr: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

56:80.wbw: A Revelation from (the) Lord (of) the worlds
56:80.tr: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

22:59.ar: لَيُدۡخِلَنَّهُم مُّدۡخَلٗا يَرۡضَوۡنَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٞ
22:59.wbw: Surely He will admit them (to) an entrance they will be pleased (with) it And indeed Allah surely (is) All-Knowing Most Forbearing
22:59.tr: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allah is Knowing and Forbearing.

2:263.ar: ۞قَوۡلٞ مَّعۡرُوفٞ وَمَغۡفِرَةٌ خَيۡرٞ مِّن صَدَقَةٖ يَتۡبَعُهَآ أَذٗىۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَلِيمٞ
2:263.wbw: A word kind and (seeking) forgiveness (are) better than a charity followed [it] (by) hurt And Allah (is) All-Sufficient All-Forbearing
2:263.tr: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allah is Free of need and Forbearing.

7:195.ar: أَلَهُمۡ أَرۡجُلٞ يَمۡشُونَ بِهَآۖ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ أَيۡدٖ يَبۡطِشُونَ بِهَآۖ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ أَعۡيُنٞ يُبۡصِرُونَ بِهَآۖ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَاذَانٞ يَسۡمَعُونَ بِهَاۗ قُلِ ٱدۡعُواْ شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ ثُمَّ كِيدُونِ فَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
7:195.wbw: Are for them feet (to) walk with [it] or for them hands (to) hold with [it] or for them eyes (to) see with [it] or for them ears (to) hear with [it]? Say "Call your partners then scheme against me and (do) not give me respite"
7:195.tr: Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, [O Muhammad], "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite.

36:17.wbw: And not (is) on us except the conveyance clear"
36:17.tr: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

22:22.ar: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْ مِنۡهَا مِنۡ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
22:22.wbw: Every time they want to come out from it from anguish they will be returned therein "Taste (the) punishment (of) the Burning Fire!"
22:22.tr: Every time they want to get out of Hellfire from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"

5:70.ar: لَقَدۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمۡ رُسُلٗاۖ كُلَّمَا جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولُۢ بِمَا لَا تَهۡوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُهُمۡ فَرِيقٗا كَذَّبُواْ وَفَرِيقٗا يَقۡتُلُونَ
5:70.wbw: Certainly We took a Covenant (from the) Children (of) Israel and We sent to them Messengers Whenever came to them any Messenger with what not desired their souls a group they denied and a group they kill
5:70.tr: We had already taken the covenant of the Children of Israel and had sent to them messengers. Whenever there came to them a messenger with what their souls did not desire, a party [of messengers] they denied, and another party they killed.

18:79.ar: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنۡ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٞ يَأۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصۡبٗا
18:79.wbw: As for the ship it was of (the) poor people working in the sea So I intended that I cause defect (in) it (as there) was after them a king who seized every ship (by) force
18:79.tr: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.

21:47.ar: وَنَضَعُ ٱلۡمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ أَتَيۡنَا بِهَاۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
21:47.wbw: And We set the scales (of) the justice for (the) Day (of) the Resurrection so not will be wronged any soul (in) anything And if (there) be weight (of) a seed of a mustard We will bring [with] it And sufficient (are) We (as) Reckoners
21:47.tr: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.

3:87.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ أَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَعۡنَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
3:87.wbw: Those - their recompense that on them (is the) curse (of) Allah and the Angels and the people all together
3:87.tr: Those - their recompense will be that upon them is the curse of Allah and the angels and the people, all together,

37:69.wbw: Indeed they found their fathers astray
37:69.tr: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

4:57.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَنُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ لَّهُمۡ فِيهَآ أَزۡوَٰجٞ مُّطَهَّرَةٞۖ وَنُدۡخِلُهُمۡ ظِلّٗا ظَلِيلًا
4:57.wbw: And those who believe[d] and did the good deeds We will admit them (in) Gardens flows from underneath it the rivers will abide in it forever For them in it (are) spouses pure and We will admit them (in the) shade thick
4:57.tr: But those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide forever. For them therein are purified spouses, and We will admit them to deepening shade.

77:30.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ
77:30.wbw: Proceed to a shadow having three columns
77:30.tr: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

23:2.wbw: Those who [they] during their prayers (are) humbly submissive
23:2.tr: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive

65:2.ar: فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٖ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجٗا
65:2.wbw: Then when they have reached their term then retain them with kindness or part with them with kindness And take witness two men just among you and establish the testimony for Allah That is instructed with it whoever [is] believes in Allah and the Day the Last And whoever fears Allah He will make for him a way out
65:2.tr: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out

42:16.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ٱسۡتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمۡ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٞ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٌ
42:16.wbw: And those who argue concerning Allah after after [what] response has been made to Him response has been made to Him their argument (is) invalid with their Lord and upon them (is) wrath and for them (is) a punishment severe
42:16.tr: And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

7:154.ar: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَن مُّوسَى ٱلۡغَضَبُ أَخَذَ ٱلۡأَلۡوَاحَۖ وَفِي نُسۡخَتِهَا هُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِرَبِّهِمۡ يَرۡهَبُونَ
7:154.wbw: And when was calmed from Musa the anger he took (up) the tablets and in their inscription (was) guidance and mercy for those who [they] of their Lord (are) fearful
7:154.tr: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord.

6:37.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةٗ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
6:37.wbw: And they said "Why (is) not sent down to him a Sign from his Lord?" Say "Indeed Allah (is) Able [on] to send down a Sign but most of them (do) not know"
6:37.tr: And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allah is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."

2:126.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنٗا وَٱرۡزُقۡ أَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ مِنۡهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ قَالَ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَأُمَتِّعُهُۥ قَلِيلٗا ثُمَّ أَضۡطَرُّهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلنَّارِۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
2:126.wbw: And when said Ibrahim "My Lord make this a city secure and provide its people with fruits (to) whoever believed from them in Allah and the Day the Last" He said "And whoever disbelieved [then] I will grant him enjoyment a little; then I will force him to (the) punishment (of) the Fire and evil (is) the destination
2:126.tr: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allah and the Last Day." [Allah] said. "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."

16:7.ar: وَتَحۡمِلُ أَثۡقَالَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلۡأَنفُسِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
16:7.wbw: And they carry your loads to a land not you could reach it except with great trouble (to) yourselves Indeed your Lord surely is Most Kind Most Merciful
16:7.tr: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

89:8.ar: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
89:8.wbw: Which not had been created like them in the cities
89:8.tr: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

21:80.ar: وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ صَنۡعَةَ لَبُوسٖ لَّكُمۡ لِتُحۡصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأۡسِكُمۡۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُمۡ شَٰكِرُونَ
21:80.wbw: And We taught him (the) making (of) coats of armor for you to protect you from your battle Then will you (be) grateful?
21:80.tr: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?

10:22.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا كُنتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَجَرَيۡنَ بِهِم بِرِيحٖ طَيِّبَةٖ وَفَرِحُواْ بِهَا جَآءَتۡهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٞ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡجُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أُحِيطَ بِهِمۡ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ لَئِنۡ أَنجَيۡتَنَا مِنۡ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
10:22.wbw: He (is) the One Who enables you to travel in the land and the sea until when you are in the ships and they sail with them with a wind good and they rejoice therein comes to it a wind stormy and comes to them the waves from every place and they assume that they are surrounded with them They call Allah sincerely to Him (in) the religion (saying) If You save us from this surely we will be among the thankful"
10:22.tr: It is He who enables you to travel on land and sea until, when you are in ships and they sail with them by a good wind and they rejoice therein, there comes a storm wind and the waves come upon them from everywhere and they assume that they are surrounded, supplicating Allah, sincere to Him in religion, "If You should save us from this, we will surely be among the thankful."

4:147.ar: مَّا يَفۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بِعَذَابِكُمۡ إِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ وَءَامَنتُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ شَاكِرًا عَلِيمٗا
4:147.wbw: What would do Allah by punishing you if you are grateful and you believe? And is Allah All-Appreciative All-Knowing
4:147.tr: What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe? And ever is Allah Appreciative and Knowing.

26:84.ar: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
26:84.wbw: And grant [for] me a mention (of) honor among the later (generations)
26:84.tr: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.

17:80.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِي مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقٖ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِي مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقٖ وَٱجۡعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَٰنٗا نَّصِيرٗا
17:80.wbw: And say "My Lord! Cause me to enter an entrance sound and cause me to exit an exit sound and make for me from near You an authority helping"
17:80.tr: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."

92:20.wbw: Except seeking (the) Countenance (of) his Lord the Most High
92:20.tr: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.

4:176.ar: يَسۡتَفۡتُونَكَ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفۡتِيكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡكَلَٰلَةِۚ إِنِ ٱمۡرُؤٌاْ هَلَكَ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٞ وَلَهُۥٓ أُخۡتٞ فَلَهَا نِصۡفُ مَا تَرَكَۚ وَهُوَ يَرِثُهَآ إِن لَّمۡ يَكُن لَّهَا وَلَدٞۚ فَإِن كَانَتَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَلَهُمَا ٱلثُّلُثَانِ مِمَّا تَرَكَۚ وَإِن كَانُوٓاْ إِخۡوَةٗ رِّجَالٗا وَنِسَآءٗ فَلِلذَّكَرِ مِثۡلُ حَظِّ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِۗ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ أَن تَضِلُّواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ
4:176.wbw: They seek your ruling Say "Allah gives you a ruling concerning the Kalala if a man died (and) not he has a child and he has a sister then for her (is) a half (of) what he left And he will inherit from her if not is for her a child But if there were two females then for them two thirds of what he left But if they were brothers and sisters men and women then the male will have like share (of) the two females makes clear Allah to you lest you go astray And Allah of every thing (is) All-Knower
4:176.tr: They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, "Allah gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more], they will have two-thirds of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females. Allah makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

40:82.ar: أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةٗ وَءَاثَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
40:82.wbw: Do they not travel through the land and see how was (the) end (of) those who (were) before them? (were) before them? They were more numerous than them and mightier (in) strength and impressions in the land but not availed them what they used (to) earn
40:82.tr: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

9:97.ar: ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفۡرٗا وَنِفَاقٗا وَأَجۡدَرُ أَلَّا يَعۡلَمُواْ حُدُودَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ
9:97.wbw: The bedouins (are) stronger (in) disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely that not they know (the) limits (of) what Allah (has) revealed Allah (has) revealed to His Messenger And Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise
9:97.tr: The bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to know the limits of what [laws] Allah has revealed to His Messenger. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

37:147.ar: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
37:147.wbw: And We sent him to a hundred thousand or more
37:147.tr: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

4:33.ar: وَلِكُلّٖ جَعَلۡنَا مَوَٰلِيَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ ٱلۡوَٰلِدَانِ وَٱلۡأَقۡرَبُونَۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ عَقَدَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡ فَـَٔاتُوهُمۡ نَصِيبَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدًا
4:33.wbw: And for all We (have) made heirs of what (is) left (by) the parents and the relatives And those whom pledged your right hands - then give them their share Indeed Allah is over every thing a Witness
4:33.tr: And for all, We have made heirs to what is left by parents and relatives. And to those whom your oaths have bound [to you] - give them their share. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, a Witness.

15:67.wbw: And came (the) people (of) the city rejoicing
15:67.tr: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

4:151.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ حَقّٗاۚ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٗا مُّهِينٗا
4:151.wbw: Those - they (are) the disbelievers truly And We have prepared for the disbelievers a punishment humiliating
4:151.tr: Those are the disbelievers, truly. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.

44:51.wbw: Indeed the righteous (will be) in a place secure
44:51.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;

37:164.ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
37:164.wbw: "And not among us except for him (is) a position known
37:164.tr: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.

55:46.wbw: But for (him) who fears (the) standing (before) his Lord (are) two gardens
55:46.tr: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -

81:21.wbw: One to be obeyed and trustworthy
81:21.tr: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

74:48.wbw: Then not will benefit them intercession (of) the intercessors
74:48.tr: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

26:202.wbw: And it will come to them suddenly while they (do) not perceive
26:202.tr: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

55:6.wbw: And the stars and the trees both prostrate
55:6.tr: And the stars and trees prostrate.

5:23.ar: قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمَا ٱدۡخُلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلۡتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمۡ غَٰلِبُونَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓاْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
5:23.wbw: Said two men from those who feared (Allah) (had) favored Allah [on] both of them "Enter upon them (through) the gate then when you have entered it then indeed, you (will be) victorious And upon Allah then put your trust if you are believers
5:23.tr: Said two men from those who feared [to disobey] upon whom Allah had bestowed favor, "Enter upon them through the gate, for when you have entered it, you will be predominant. And upon Allah rely, if you should be believers."

3:160.ar: إِن يَنصُرۡكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَخۡذُلۡكُمۡ فَمَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَنصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
3:160.wbw: If helps you Allah then not (can) overcome [for] you and if He forsakes you then who (is) the one who can help you from? after Him? And on Allah let put (their) trust the believers
3:160.tr: If Allah should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him? And upon Allah let the believers rely.

37:116.wbw: And We helped them so they became so they became the victors
37:116.tr: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

18:44.ar: هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡوَلَٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٌ عُقۡبٗا
18:44.wbw: There the protection (is) from Allah the True He (is the) best (to) reward and (the) best (for) the final end
18:44.tr: There the authority is [completely] for Allah, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.

16:29.ar: فَٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
16:29.wbw: So enter (the) gates (of) Hell (to) abide forever in it Surely wretched (is the) abode (of) the arrogant
16:29.tr: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.

47:29.ar: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخۡرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضۡغَٰنَهُمۡ
47:29.wbw: Or do think those who in their hearts (is) a disease that never will Allah bring forth will Allah bring forth their hatred?
47:29.tr: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?

23:102.ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
23:102.wbw: Then (the one) whose (are) heavy his scales then those - they (are) the successful
23:102.tr: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

79:11.wbw: What! When we are bones decayed?"
79:11.tr: Even if we should be decayed bones?

36:14.ar: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٖ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
36:14.wbw: When We sent to them two (Messengers) but they denied both of them so We strengthened them with a third and they said "Indeed We to you (are) Messengers"
36:14.tr: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

56:7.wbw: And you will become kinds three

36:29.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
36:29.wbw: Not it was but a shout one then behold! They (were) extinguished
36:29.tr: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

15:73.wbw: So seized them the awful cry at sunrise
15:73.tr: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.

54:31.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
54:31.wbw: Indeed We [We] sent upon them thunderous blast single and they became like dry twig fragments (used by) a fence builder
54:31.tr: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

42:7.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ فَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلسَّعِيرِ
42:7.wbw: And thus We have revealed to you a Quran (in) Arabic that you may warn (the) mother (of) the towns and whoever (is) around it and warn (of the) Day (of) Assembly (there is) no doubt in it A party (will be) in Paradise and a party in the Blazing Fire
42:7.tr: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur'an that you may warn the Mother of Cities [Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

26:61.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
26:61.wbw: Then when saw each other the two hosts said (the) companions (of) Musa "Indeed we (are) surely to be overtaken"
26:61.tr: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

3:162.ar: أَفَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضۡوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَنۢ بَآءَ بِسَخَطٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
3:162.wbw: So is (the one) who pursues (the) pleasure (of) Allah like (the one) who draws on (himself) wrath of Allah and his abode (is) hell and wretched (is) the destination?
3:162.tr: So is one who pursues the pleasure of Allah like one who brings upon himself the anger of Allah and whose refuge is Hell? And wretched is the destination.

83:33.wbw: But not they had been sent over them (as) guardians
83:33.tr: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

19:8.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٗا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيّٗا
19:8.wbw: He said "My Lord! How can I have a boy while is my wife barren and indeed I have reached of the old age extreme?"
19:8.tr: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"

19:19.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمٗا زَكِيّٗا
19:19.wbw: He said "Only I am a Messenger (from) your Lord that I (may) bestow on you a son pure"
19:19.tr: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."

27:11.ar: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
27:11.wbw: Except who wrongs then substitutes good after evil then indeed I Am Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
27:11.tr: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.

58:13.ar: ءَأَشۡفَقۡتُمۡ أَن تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ نَجۡوَىٰكُمۡ صَدَقَٰتٖۚ فَإِذۡ لَمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
58:13.wbw: Are you afraid to offer before before your private consultation charities? Then when you do not you do not and Allah has forgiven and Allah has forgiven you then establish the prayer and give the zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger And Allah (is) All-Aware of what you do
58:13.tr: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

2:205.ar: وَإِذَا تَوَلَّىٰ سَعَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيُفۡسِدَ فِيهَا وَيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡحَرۡثَ وَٱلنَّسۡلَۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡفَسَادَ
2:205.wbw: And when he turns away he strives in the earth to spread corruption [in it] and destroys the crops and progeny And Allah (does) not love [the] corruption
2:205.tr: And when he goes away, he strives throughout the land to cause corruption therein and destroy crops and animals. And Allah does not like corruption.

3:117.ar: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٖ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتۡ حَرۡثَ قَوۡمٖ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَأَهۡلَكَتۡهُۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنۡ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
3:117.wbw: Example (of) what they spend in this [the] life (of) the world (is) like (the) example (of) a wind in it (is) frost it struck (the) harvest (of) a people who wronged themselves then destroyed it And not (has) wronged them Allah [and] but themselves they wronged
3:117.tr: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves and destroys it. And Allah has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves.

21:78.ar: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ إِذۡ يَحۡكُمَانِ فِي ٱلۡحَرۡثِ إِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شَٰهِدِينَ
21:78.wbw: And Dawud and Sulaiman when they judged concerning the field when pastured in it sheep (of) a people and We were to their judgment witness
21:78.tr: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.

3:167.ar: وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُواْۚ وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ قَٰتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوِ ٱدۡفَعُواْۖ قَالُواْ لَوۡ نَعۡلَمُ قِتَالٗا لَّٱتَّبَعۡنَٰكُمۡۗ هُمۡ لِلۡكُفۡرِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ أَقۡرَبُ مِنۡهُمۡ لِلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفۡوَٰهِهِم مَّا لَيۡسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَكۡتُمُونَ
3:167.wbw: And that He (might) make evident those who (are) hypocrites And it was said to them "Come fight in (the) way (of) Allah or defend" They said "If we knew fighting certainly we (would have) followed you" They - to disbelief that day (were) nearer than [them] to the faith saying with their mouths what was not in their hearts And Allah (is) Most Knowing (of) what they conceal
3:167.tr: And that He might make evident those who are hypocrites. For it was said to them, "Come, fight in the way of Allah or [at least] defend." They said, "If we had known [there would be] fighting, we would have followed you." They were nearer to disbelief that day than to faith, saying with their mouths what was not in their hearts. And Allah is most Knowing of what they conceal -

53:9.wbw: And was (at) a distance (of) two bow-(lengths) or nearer
53:9.tr: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

33:59.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزۡوَٰجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَآءِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يُدۡنِينَ عَلَيۡهِنَّ مِن جَلَٰبِيبِهِنَّۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدۡنَىٰٓ أَن يُعۡرَفۡنَ فَلَا يُؤۡذَيۡنَۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
33:59.wbw: O Prophet! O Prophet! Say to your wives and your daughters and (the) women (of) the believers to bring down over themselves of their outer garments That (is) more suitable that they should be known and not harmed And is Allah Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
33:59.tr: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

12:55.ar: قَالَ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَآئِنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٞ
12:55.wbw: He said "Appoint me over (the) treasuries (of) the land Indeed I (will be) a guardian knowing"
12:55.tr: [Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."

17:27.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓاْ إِخۡوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورٗا
17:27.wbw: Indeed the spendthrifts are brothers (of) the devils And is the Shaitaan to his Lord ungrateful
17:27.tr: Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.

2:37.ar: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
2:37.wbw: Then received Adam from his Lord words So (his Lord) turned towards him Indeed He! He (is) the Oft-returning (to mercy) the Most Merciful
2:37.tr: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

9:104.ar: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ يَقۡبَلُ ٱلتَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَأۡخُذُ ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
9:104.wbw: Do not they know that Allah (is) He (Who) accepts the repentance from His slaves and takes the charities and that Allah He (is) the Acceptor of repentance the Most Merciful
9:104.tr: Do they not know that it is Allah who accepts repentance from His servants and receives charities and that it is Allah who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful?

4:16.ar: وَٱلَّذَانِ يَأۡتِيَٰنِهَا مِنكُمۡ فَـَٔاذُوهُمَاۖ فَإِن تَابَا وَأَصۡلَحَا فَأَعۡرِضُواْ عَنۡهُمَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ تَوَّابٗا رَّحِيمًا
4:16.wbw: And the two who commit it among you then punish both of them But if they repent and correct themselves then turn away from both of them Indeed Allah is Oft-forgiving Most-Merciful
4:16.tr: And the two who commit it among you, dishonor them both. But if they repent and correct themselves, leave them alone. Indeed, Allah is ever Accepting of repentance and Merciful.

38:48.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
38:48.wbw: And remember Ismail and Al-Yasa and Dhul-kifl and Dhul-kifl and all (are) from the best
38:48.tr: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

4:141.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَرَبَّصُونَ بِكُمۡ فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ فَتۡحٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ قَالُوٓاْ أَلَمۡ نَكُن مَّعَكُمۡ وَإِن كَانَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ نَصِيبٞ قَالُوٓاْ أَلَمۡ نَسۡتَحۡوِذۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَنَمۡنَعۡكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۚ فَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَلَن يَجۡعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ سَبِيلًا
4:141.wbw: Those who are waiting for you Then if was for you a victory from Allah they say "Were not we with you?" But if (there) was for the disbelievers a chance they said "Did not we have advantage over you and we protected you from the believers?" And Allah will judge between you (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection and never will make Allah for the disbelievers over the believers a way
4:141.tr: Those who wait [and watch] you. Then if you gain a victory from Allah, they say, "Were we not with you?" But if the disbelievers have a success, they say [to them], "Did we not gain the advantage over you, but we protected you from the believers?" Allah will judge between [all of] you on the Day of Resurrection, and never will Allah give the disbelievers over the believers a way [to overcome them].

32:28.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡفَتۡحُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
32:28.wbw: And they say "When (will be) this decision if you are truthful?"
32:28.tr: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"

26:205.wbw: Then have you seen if We let them enjoy (for) years
26:205.tr: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

37:61.wbw: For (the) like (of) this let work the workers
37:61.tr: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

11:121.ar: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنَّا عَٰمِلُونَ
11:121.wbw: And say to those who (do) not believe "Work (according) to your position; indeed we (are also) working
11:121.tr: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.

39:62.ar: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ
39:62.wbw: Allah (is the) Creator (of) all things and He (is) over all things a Guardian
39:62.tr: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

24:57.ar: لَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
24:57.wbw: (Do) not think those who disbelieve (can) escape in the earth And their abode (will be) the Fire and wretched is the destination
24:57.tr: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allah] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.

20:58.ar: فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانٗا سُوٗى
20:58.wbw: Then we will surely produce for you magic like it So make between us and between you an appointment not we will fail it [we] and not you (in) a place even"
20:58.tr: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."

14:45.ar: وَسَكَنتُمۡ فِي مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ فَعَلۡنَا بِهِمۡ وَضَرَبۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ
14:45.wbw: And you dwelt in the dwellings (of) those who wronged themselves and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them and We put forth for you the examples"
