14:45.tr: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."

10:105.ar: وَأَنۡ أَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفٗا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
10:105.wbw: And that "Direct your face to the religion upright and (do) not be of the polytheists
10:105.tr: And [commanded], 'Direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allah;

6:79.ar: إِنِّي وَجَّهۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
6:79.wbw: Indeed I [I] have turned my face to the One Who created the heavens and the earth (as) a true monotheist and not I (am) of the polytheists
6:79.tr: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah."

76:2.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
76:2.wbw: Indeed We [We] created man from a sperm-drop mixture (that) We test him; so We made (for) him hearing and sight
76:2.tr: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

23:13.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُطۡفَةٗ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٖ
23:13.wbw: Then We placed him (as) a semen-drop in a resting place firm
23:13.tr: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.

16:4.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
16:4.wbw: He created the human kind from a minute quantity of semen then behold he (is) an opponent clear
16:4.tr: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.

2:124.ar: ۞وَإِذِ ٱبۡتَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِـۧمَ رَبُّهُۥ بِكَلِمَٰتٖ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّۖ قَالَ إِنِّي جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامٗاۖ قَالَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۖ قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهۡدِي ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
2:124.wbw: And when tried Ibrahim his Lord with words and he fulfilled them He said "Indeed I (am) the One to make you for the mankind a leader" He said "And from my offspring?" He said "(Does) not reach My Covenant (to) the wrongdoers"
2:124.tr: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with commands and he fulfilled them. [Allah] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allah] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."

46:12.ar: وَمِن قَبۡلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامٗا وَرَحۡمَةٗۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٞ مُّصَدِّقٞ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
46:12.wbw: And before it And before it (was the) Scripture (of) Musa (as) a guide and a mercy And this (is) a Book confirming (in) language Arabic to warn those who do wrong and (as) a glad tidings for the good-doers
46:12.tr: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

53:38.wbw: That not will bear a bearer of burdens (the) burden (of) another
53:38.tr: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

51:33.wbw: That we may send down upon them stones of clay
51:33.tr: To send down upon them stones of clay,

4:36.ar: ۞وَٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُشۡرِكُواْ بِهِۦ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنٗا وَبِذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱلۡجَارِ ذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡجَارِ ٱلۡجُنُبِ وَٱلصَّاحِبِ بِٱلۡجَنۢبِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ مُخۡتَالٗا فَخُورًا
4:36.wbw: And worship Allah And (do) not associate with Him anything and to the parents (do) good and with the relatives and the orphans and the needy and the neighbor (who is) near and the neighbor (who is) farther away and the companion by your side and the traveler and what possess[ed] your right hands Indeed Allah (does) not love (the one) who is [a] proud (and) [a] boastful
4:36.tr: Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good, and to relatives, orphans, the needy, the near neighbor, the neighbor farther away, the companion at your side, the traveler, and those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allah does not like those who are self-deluding and boastful.

59:16.ar: كَمَثَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ إِذۡ قَالَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ ٱكۡفُرۡ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّنكَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
59:16.wbw: Like (the) example (of) the Shaitaan when he says to man "Disbelieve" But when he disbelieves he says "Indeed I am disassociated from you Indeed [I] I fear Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds"
59:16.tr: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds."

11:35.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ إِنِ ٱفۡتَرَيۡتُهُۥ فَعَلَيَّ إِجۡرَامِي وَأَنَا۠ بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُجۡرِمُونَ
11:35.wbw: Or (do) they say "He has invented it?" Say "If I have invented it then on me (is) my crime but I am innocent of what crimes you commit"
11:35.tr: Or do they say [about Prophet Muhammad], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."

6:78.ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ بَازِغَةٗ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي هَٰذَآ أَكۡبَرُۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتۡ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُونَ
6:78.wbw: When he saw the sun rising he said "This (is) my Lord this (is) greater" But when it set he said "O my people! Indeed I am free of what you associate (with Allah)"
6:78.tr: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allah.

6:143.ar: ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۖ مِّنَ ٱلضَّأۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَمِنَ ٱلۡمَعۡزِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۗ قُلۡ ءَآلذَّكَرَيۡنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِ أَمَّا ٱشۡتَمَلَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَرۡحَامُ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِۖ نَبِّـُٔونِي بِعِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
6:143.wbw: Eight pairs of the sheep two and of the goats two Say "(Are) the two males He has forbidden or the two females or what contains [in it] (the) wombs (of) the two females? Inform me with knowledge if you are truthful"
6:143.tr: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful."

24:32.ar: وَأَنكِحُواْ ٱلۡأَيَٰمَىٰ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ مِنۡ عِبَادِكُمۡ وَإِمَآئِكُمۡۚ إِن يَكُونُواْ فُقَرَآءَ يُغۡنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ
24:32.wbw: And marry the single among you and the righteous among your male slaves and your female slaves If they are poor Allah will enrich them Allah will enrich them from His Bounty And Allah (is) All-Encompassing All-Knowing
24:32.tr: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty, and Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

4:62.ar: فَكَيۡفَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتۡهُم مُّصِيبَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ ثُمَّ جَآءُوكَ يَحۡلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَدۡنَآ إِلَّآ إِحۡسَٰنٗا وَتَوۡفِيقًا
4:62.wbw: So how when befalls them disaster for what sent forth their hands then they come to you swearing by Allah "Not we intended except good and reconciliation"
4:62.tr: So how [will it be] when disaster strikes them because of what their hands have put forth and then they come to you swearing by Allah, "We intended nothing but good conduct and accommodation."

49:12.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱجۡتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثۡمٞۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغۡتَب بَّعۡضُكُم بَعۡضًاۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن يَأۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ أَخِيهِ مَيۡتٗا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوهُۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٞ رَّحِيمٞ
49:12.wbw: O you who believe! O you who believe! O you who believe! Avoid much of the assumption Indeed some assumption (is) sin And (do) not spy and (do) not backbite some of you (to) others Would like one of you to eat (the) flesh (of) his brother dead? Nay, you would hate it And fear Allah And fear Allah indeed Allah (is) Oft-Returning Most Merciful
49:12.tr: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.

16:14.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۡهُ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُواْ مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
16:14.wbw: And He (is) the One Who subjected the sea for you to eat from it meat fresh and that you bring forth from it ornaments (that) you wear them And you see the ships ploughing through it and that you may seek of His Bounty and that you may (be) grateful
16:14.tr: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

25:73.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمّٗا وَعُمۡيَانٗا
25:73.wbw: And those who when they are reminded of (the) Verses (of) their Lord (do) not fall upon them deaf and blind
25:73.tr: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

26:177.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26:177.wbw: When said to them Shuaib "Will not you fear (Allah)?
26:177.tr: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

4:172.ar: لَّن يَسۡتَنكِفَ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبۡدٗا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَۚ وَمَن يَسۡتَنكِفۡ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَكۡبِرۡ فَسَيَحۡشُرُهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ جَمِيعٗا
4:172.wbw: Never will disdain the Messiah to be a slave of Allah and not the Angels the ones who are near (to Allah) And whoever disdains from His worship and is arrogant then He will gather them towards Him all together
4:172.tr: Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allah, nor would the angels near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant - He will gather them to Himself all together.

38:26.ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
38:26.wbw: "O Dawood! Indeed We [We] have made you a vicegerent in the earth so judge between [the] men in truth and (do) not follow the desire for it will lead you stray from (the) way (of) Allah Indeed those who go astray from (the) way (of) Allah for them (is) a punishment severe because they forgot (the) Day (of) Account"
38:26.tr: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

33:68.ar: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمۡ ضِعۡفَيۡنِ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَٱلۡعَنۡهُمۡ لَعۡنٗا كَبِيرٗا
33:68.wbw: Our Lord! Give them double [of] punishment and curse them (with) a curse great"
33:68.tr: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."

33:38.ar: مَّا كَانَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّ مِنۡ حَرَجٖ فِيمَا فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥۖ سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوۡاْ مِن قَبۡلُۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرٗا مَّقۡدُورًا
33:38.wbw: Not (there can) be upon the Prophet any discomfort in what Allah has imposed Allah has imposed on him (That is the) Way (of) Allah concerning those who passed away before before And is (the) Command (of) Allah a decree destined
33:38.tr: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allah has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allah with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allah a destiny decreed.

75:35.wbw: Then woe to you and woe!
75:35.tr: Then woe to you, and woe!

33:6.ar: ٱلنَّبِيُّ أَوۡلَىٰ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُۥٓ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡۗ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِبَعۡضٖ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُهَٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفۡعَلُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَوۡلِيَآئِكُم مَّعۡرُوفٗاۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَسۡطُورٗا
33:6.wbw: The Prophet (is) closer to the believers than their own selves and his wives (are) their mothers And possessors (of) relationships some of them (are) closer to another in (the) Decree (of) Allah than the believers and the emigrants except that you do to your friends a kindness That is That is in the Book written
33:6.tr: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.

8:75.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَهَاجَرُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ مَعَكُمۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمۡۚ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِبَعۡضٖ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ
8:75.wbw: And those who believed from afterwards and emigrated and strove hard with you then those (are) of you But those (of) blood relationship some of them (are) nearer to another in (the) Book (of) Allah Indeed Allah of every thing (is) All-Knower
8:75.tr: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things.

42:51.ar: ۞وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحۡيًا أَوۡ مِن وَرَآيِٕ حِجَابٍ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُولٗا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٞ
42:51.wbw: And not is for any human that Allah should speak to him Allah should speak to him except (by) revelation or from behind a veil or (by) sending a Messenger then he reveals by His permission what He wills Indeed, He (is) Most High Most Wise
42:51.tr: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.

10:65.ar: وَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّ ٱلۡعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًاۚ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
10:65.wbw: And (let) not grieve you their speech Indeed the honor (belongs) to Allah all He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower
10:65.tr: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

16:90.ar: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآيِٕ ذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَيَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱلۡبَغۡيِۚ يَعِظُكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
16:90.wbw: Indeed Allah commands justice and the good and giving (to) relatives (to) relatives and forbids [from] the immorality and the bad and the oppression He admonishes you so that you may take heed
16:90.tr: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

9:37.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّسِيٓءُ زِيَادَةٞ فِي ٱلۡكُفۡرِۖ يُضَلُّ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُحِلُّونَهُۥ عَامٗا وَيُحَرِّمُونَهُۥ عَامٗا لِّيُوَاطِـُٔواْ عِدَّةَ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ فَيُحِلُّواْ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُۚ زُيِّنَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ أَعۡمَٰلِهِمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
9:37.wbw: Indeed the postponing (is) an increase in the disbelief are led astray by it those who disbelieve They make it lawful one year and make it unlawful (another) year to adjust the number which Allah has made unlawful Allah has made unlawful and making lawful what Allah has made unlawful Allah has made unlawful Is made fair-seeming to them (the) evil (of) their deeds And Allah (does) not guide the people the disbelievers
9:37.tr: Indeed, the postponing [of restriction within sacred months] is an increase in disbelief by which those who have disbelieved are led [further] astray. They make it lawful one year and unlawful another year to correspond to the number made unlawful by Allah and [thus] make lawful what Allah has made unlawful. Made pleasing to them is the evil of their deeds; and Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.

33:49.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نَكَحۡتُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقۡتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِنَّ مِنۡ عِدَّةٖ تَعۡتَدُّونَهَاۖ فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحٗا جَمِيلٗا
33:49.wbw: O you who believe! O you who believe! O you who believe! When you marry believing women and then divorce them before before [that] you have touched them then not for you on them any waiting period (to) count concerning them So provide for them and release them (with) a release good
33:49.tr: O You who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.

9:52.ar: قُلۡ هَلۡ تَرَبَّصُونَ بِنَآ إِلَّآ إِحۡدَى ٱلۡحُسۡنَيَيۡنِۖ وَنَحۡنُ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمۡ أَن يُصِيبَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِعَذَابٖ مِّنۡ عِندِهِۦٓ أَوۡ بِأَيۡدِينَاۖ فَتَرَبَّصُوٓاْ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّتَرَبِّصُونَ
9:52.wbw: Say "Do you await for us except one (of) the two best (things) while we [we] await for you that Allah will afflict you Allah will afflict you with a punishment from [near] Him or by our hands? So wait indeed, we with you (are) waiting"
9:52.tr: Say, "Do you await for us except one of the two best things while we await for you that Allah will afflict you with punishment from Himself or at our hands? So wait; indeed we, along with you, are waiting."

16:10.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗۖ لَّكُم مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٞ وَمِنۡهُ شَجَرٞ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
16:10.wbw: He (is) the One Who sends down from the sky water for you of it (is) drink and from it (grows) vegetation in which you pasture your cattle
16:10.tr: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].

26:28.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
26:28.wbw: He said "Lord (of) the east and the west and whatever (is) between them if you were (to) reason"
26:28.tr: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

39:14.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي
39:14.wbw: Say "I worship Allah "I worship Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) my religion
39:14.tr: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,

44:55.wbw: They will call therein for every kind (of) fruit secure
44:55.tr: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

58:21.ar: كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَغۡلِبَنَّ أَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِيٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٞ
58:21.wbw: Allah has decreed Allah has decreed "Surely, I will overcome I and My Messengers" Indeed Allah (is) All-Strong All-Mighty
58:21.tr: Allah has written, "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

19:61.ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيّٗا
19:61.wbw: Gardens (of) Eden which promised the Most Gracious (to) His slaves in the unseen Indeed [it] is His promise sure to come
19:61.tr: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.

38:50.wbw: Gardens (of) Eternity (will be) opened for them the gates
38:50.tr: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

2:245.ar: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يُقۡرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥٓ أَضۡعَافٗا كَثِيرَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡبِضُ وَيَبۡصُۜطُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
2:245.wbw: Who (is) the one who will lend (to) Allah a loan good so (that) He multiplies it for him manifolds many And Allah withholds and grants abundance and to Him you will be returned
2:245.tr: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allah who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned.

48:19.ar: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةٗ يَأۡخُذُونَهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمٗا
48:19.wbw: And spoils of war much that they will take; and is Allah All-Mighty All-Wise
48:19.tr: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.

22:9.ar: ثَانِيَ عِطۡفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ لَهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٞۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
22:9.wbw: Twisting his neck to mislead from (the) way (of) Allah For him in the world (is) disgrace and We will make him taste (on the) Day (of) Resurrection (the) punishment (of) the Burning Fire
22:9.tr: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allah. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],

13:4.ar: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قِطَعٞ مُّتَجَٰوِرَٰتٞ وَجَنَّٰتٞ مِّنۡ أَعۡنَٰبٖ وَزَرۡعٞ وَنَخِيلٞ صِنۡوَانٞ وَغَيۡرُ صِنۡوَانٖ يُسۡقَىٰ بِمَآءٖ وَٰحِدٖ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعۡضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فِي ٱلۡأُكُلِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
13:4.wbw: And in the earth are tracks neighboring and gardens of grapevines and crops and date-palms trees (growing) from a single root and not trees (growing) from a single root watered with water one but We cause to exceed some of them over others in the fruit Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for a people who use reason
13:4.tr: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.

24:20.ar: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
24:20.wbw: And if not (for the) Grace of Allah (for the) Grace of Allah upon you and His Mercy And that Allah (is) Full of Kindness Most Merciful
24:20.tr: And if it had not been for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Kind and Merciful.

3:30.ar: يَوۡمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ مُّحۡضَرٗا وَمَا عَمِلَتۡ مِن سُوٓءٖ تَوَدُّ لَوۡ أَنَّ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَهُۥٓ أَمَدَۢا بَعِيدٗاۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
3:30.wbw: (On the) day will find every soul what it did of good presented and what it did of evil it will wish [if] that between itself and between it (evil) (was) a distance great And warns you Allah (against) Himself and Allah (is) Most Kind to (His) [the] slaves
3:30.tr: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allah warns you of Himself, and Allah is Kind to [His] servants."

16:95.ar: وَلَا تَشۡتَرُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
16:95.wbw: And (do) not exchange the covenant (of) Allah (for) a price little Indeed what (is) with Allah it (is) better for you if you were (to) know
16:95.tr: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know.

15:10.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
15:10.wbw: And certainly We (had) sent before you before you in the sects (of) the former (people)
15:10.tr: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

21:53.wbw: They said "We found our forefathers of them worshippers"
21:53.tr: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

54:20.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ
54:20.wbw: Plucking out men as if they (were) trunks (of) date-palms uprooted
54:20.tr: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

3:22.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
3:22.wbw: Those (are) the ones who - became worthless their deeds in the world and (in) the Hereafter And not (will be) for them any helpers
3:22.tr: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.

26:95.tr: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

2:34.ar: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
2:34.wbw: And when We said to the angels "Prostrate to Adam" [so] they prostrated except Iblees He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers
2:34.tr: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.

18:106.ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُواْ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا
18:106.wbw: That (is) their recompense - Hell - because they disbelieved and took My Verses and My Messengers (in) ridicule
18:106.tr: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.

51:39.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ
51:39.wbw: But he turned away with his supporters and said "A magician or a madman"
51:39.tr: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

20:62.wbw: Then they disputed (in) their affair among them and they kept secret the private conversation
20:62.tr: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

58:10.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ لِيَحۡزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيۡسَ بِضَآرِّهِمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
58:10.wbw: Only the secret counsels (are) from the Shaitaan that he may grieve those who believe but not he (can) harm them (in) anything except by Allah's permission by Allah's permission And upon Allah let put (their) trust the believers
58:10.tr: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

28:83.ar: تِلۡكَ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ نَجۡعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوّٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فَسَادٗاۚ وَٱلۡعَٰقِبَةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
28:83.wbw: That the Home (of) the Hereafter We assign it to those who (do) not desire exaltedness in the earth and not corruption And the good end (is) for the righteous
28:83.tr: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

20:7.ar: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى
20:7.wbw: And if you speak aloud the word then indeed He knows the secret and the more hidden
20:7.tr: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

7:188.ar: قُل لَّآ أَمۡلِكُ لِنَفۡسِي نَفۡعٗا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَلَوۡ كُنتُ أَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ لَٱسۡتَكۡثَرۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِيَ ٱلسُّوٓءُۚ إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ وَبَشِيرٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
7:188.wbw: Say "Not "I have power for myself (to) benefit and no (power to) harm except what wills Allah And if I would know (of) the unseen surely I could have multiplied of the good and not (could) have touched me the evil Not (am) I except a warner and a bearer of good tidings to a people who believe"
7:188.tr: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allah has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe."

6:81.ar: وَكَيۡفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشۡرَكۡتُمۡ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمۡ أَشۡرَكۡتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهِۦ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٗاۚ فَأَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلۡأَمۡنِۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
6:81.wbw: And how could I fear what you associate (with Allah) while not you fear that you have associated with Allah what not did He send down for it to you any authority So which (of) the two parties has more right to security if you know?"
6:81.tr: And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allah that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?

9:108.ar: لَا تَقُمۡ فِيهِ أَبَدٗاۚ لَّمَسۡجِدٌ أُسِّسَ عَلَى ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ مِنۡ أَوَّلِ يَوۡمٍ أَحَقُّ أَن تَقُومَ فِيهِۚ فِيهِ رِجَالٞ يُحِبُّونَ أَن يَتَطَهَّرُواْۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُطَّهِّرِينَ
9:108.wbw: (Do) not stand in it ever A masjid founded on the righteousness from (the) first day (is) more worthy that you stand in it Within it (are) men who love to purify themselves and Allah loves the ones who purify themselves
9:108.tr: Do not stand [for prayer] within it - ever. A mosque founded on righteousness from the first day is more worthy for you to stand in. Within it are men who love to purify themselves; and Allah loves those who purify themselves.

17:3.ar: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبۡدٗا شَكُورٗا
17:3.wbw: Offsprings (of one) who We carried with Nuh Indeed he was a servant grateful
17:3.tr: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.

64:17.ar: إِن تُقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا يُضَٰعِفۡهُ لَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
64:17.wbw: If you loan (to) Allah a loan goodly He will multiply it for you and will forgive you And Allah (is) Most Appreciative Most Forbearing
64:17.tr: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.

14:15.wbw: And they sought victory and disappointed every tyrant obstinate
14:15.tr: And they requested victory from Allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.

2:260.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِي كَيۡفَ تُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۖ قَالَ أَوَلَمۡ تُؤۡمِنۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَطۡمَئِنَّ قَلۡبِيۖ قَالَ فَخُذۡ أَرۡبَعَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَصُرۡهُنَّ إِلَيۡكَ ثُمَّ ٱجۡعَلۡ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٖ مِّنۡهُنَّ جُزۡءٗا ثُمَّ ٱدۡعُهُنَّ يَأۡتِينَكَ سَعۡيٗاۚ وَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ
2:260.wbw: And when said Ibrahim "My Lord show me how You give life (to) the dead" He said "Have not you believed?" He said "Yes [and] but to satisfy my heart" He said "Then take four of the birds and incline them towards you then put on each hill of them a portion then call them they will come to you (in) haste And know that Allah (is) All-Mighty All-Wise
2:260.tr: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead." [Allah] said, "Have you not believed?" He said, "Yes, but [I ask] only that my heart may be satisfied." [Allah] said, "Take four birds and commit them to yourself. Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them; then call them - they will come [flying] to you in haste. And know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise."

18:32.ar: ۞وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلٗا رَّجُلَيۡنِ جَعَلۡنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيۡنِ مِنۡ أَعۡنَٰبٖ وَحَفَفۡنَٰهُمَا بِنَخۡلٖ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمَا زَرۡعٗا
18:32.wbw: And set forth to them the example of two men: We provided for one of them two gardens of grapes and We bordered them with date-palms and We placed between both of them crops
18:32.tr: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.

6:145.ar: قُل لَّآ أَجِدُ فِي مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٖ يَطۡعَمُهُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَكُونَ مَيۡتَةً أَوۡ دَمٗا مَّسۡفُوحًا أَوۡ لَحۡمَ خِنزِيرٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ رِجۡسٌ أَوۡ فِسۡقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦۚ فَمَنِ ٱضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٖ وَلَا عَادٖ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
6:145.wbw: Say "Not "(do) I find in what has been revealed to me (anything) forbidden to an eater who eats it except that it be dead or blood poured forth or (the) flesh (of) swine for indeed, it (is) filth or (it be) disobedience [is] dedicated to other than Allah [on it] But whoever (is) compelled not desiring and not transgressing then indeed your Lord (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful"
6:145.tr: Say, "I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], then indeed, your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."

7:26.ar: يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ قَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِبَاسٗا يُوَٰرِي سَوۡءَٰتِكُمۡ وَرِيشٗاۖ وَلِبَاسُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
7:26.wbw: O Children (of) Adam! Verily We have sent down to you clothing it covers your shame and (as) an adornment But the clothing (of) [the] righteousness that (is) best That (is) from (the) Signs (of) Allah so that they may remember
7:26.tr: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember.

78:10.wbw: And We made the night (as) covering
78:10.tr: And made the night as clothing

2:187.ar: أُحِلَّ لَكُمۡ لَيۡلَةَ ٱلصِّيَامِ ٱلرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَآئِكُمۡۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٞ لَّكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لِبَاسٞ لَّهُنَّۗ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَخۡتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَعَفَا عَنكُمۡۖ فَٱلۡـَٰٔنَ بَٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۚ وَكُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡخَيۡطُ ٱلۡأَبۡيَضُ مِنَ ٱلۡخَيۡطِ ٱلۡأَسۡوَدِ مِنَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّواْ ٱلصِّيَامَ إِلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۚ وَلَا تُبَٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمۡ عَٰكِفُونَ فِي ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدِۗ تِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَقۡرَبُوهَاۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
2:187.wbw: Permitted for you (in the) nights (of) fasting (is) the approach to your wives They (are) garments for you and you (are) garments for them Knows Allah that you used to deceive yourselves so He turned towards you and He forgave [on] you So now have relations with them and seek what has ordained Allah for you And eat and drink until becomes distinct to you the thread [the] white from the thread [the] black of [the] dawn Then complete the fast till the night And (do) not have relations with them while you (are) secluded in the masajid These (are the) limits (set by) Allah so (do) not approach them Thus makes clear Allah His verses for [the] people so that they may (become) righteous
2:187.tr: It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek that which Allah has decreed for you. And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread [of night]. Then complete the fast until the sunset. And do not have relations with them as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques. These are the limits [set by] Allah, so do not approach them. Thus does Allah make clear His ordinances to the people that they may become righteous.

4:112.ar: وَمَن يَكۡسِبۡ خَطِيٓـَٔةً أَوۡ إِثۡمٗا ثُمَّ يَرۡمِ بِهِۦ بَرِيٓـٔٗا فَقَدِ ٱحۡتَمَلَ بُهۡتَٰنٗا وَإِثۡمٗا مُّبِينٗا
4:112.wbw: And whoever earns a fault or a sin then throws it (on) an innocent then surely he (has) burdened (himself) (with) a slander and a sin manifest
4:112.tr: But whoever earns an offense or a sin and then blames it on an innocent [person] has taken upon himself a slander and manifest sin.

12:60.ar: فَإِن لَّمۡ تَأۡتُونِي بِهِۦ فَلَا كَيۡلَ لَكُمۡ عِندِي وَلَا تَقۡرَبُونِ
12:60.wbw: But if not you bring him to me you bring him to me then (there will be) no measure for you from me and not you will come near me"
12:60.tr: But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."

114:6.tr: From among the jinn and mankind."

23:25.ar: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلُۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٞ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
23:25.wbw: Not he (is) but a man in him (is) madness so wait concerning him until a time"
23:25.tr: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

12:89.ar: قَالَ هَلۡ عَلِمۡتُم مَّا فَعَلۡتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذۡ أَنتُمۡ جَٰهِلُونَ
12:89.wbw: He said "Do you know what you did with Yusuf and his brother when you were ignorant?"
12:89.tr: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"

11:39.ar: فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ
11:39.wbw: And soon you will know (on) whom will come a punishment (that) will disgrace him and will descend on him a punishment lasting"
11:39.tr: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."

9:21.ar: يُبَشِّرُهُمۡ رَبُّهُم بِرَحۡمَةٖ مِّنۡهُ وَرِضۡوَٰنٖ وَجَنَّٰتٖ لَّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَعِيمٞ مُّقِيمٌ
9:21.wbw: Their Lord gives them glad tidings Their Lord gives them glad tidings of Mercy from Him and Pleasure and Gardens for them in it (is) bliss enduring
9:21.tr: Their Lord gives them good tidings of mercy from Him and approval and of gardens for them wherein is enduring pleasure.

36:32.ar: وَإِن كُلّٞ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
36:32.wbw: And surely all then together before Us (will be) brought
36:32.tr: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

40:46.ar: ٱلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوّٗا وَعَشِيّٗاۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡخِلُوٓاْ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
40:46.wbw: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening And (the) Day (will be) established the Hour "Cause to enter (the) people (of) Firaun (in the) severest punishment"
40:46.tr: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."

18:43.ar: وَلَمۡ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٞ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا
18:43.wbw: And not was for him a group (to) help him other than other than Allah and not was (he) supported
18:43.tr: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor could he defend himself.

2:249.ar: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلۡجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبۡتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٖ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنۡهُ فَلَيۡسَ مِنِّي وَمَن لَّمۡ يَطۡعَمۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّيٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغۡتَرَفَ غُرۡفَةَۢ بِيَدِهِۦۚ فَشَرِبُواْ مِنۡهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّنۡهُمۡۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ قَالُواْ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٖ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتۡ فِئَةٗ كَثِيرَةَۢ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
2:249.wbw: Then when set out Talut with the forces he said "Indeed Allah will test you with a river So whoever drinks from it then he is not from me and whoever (does) not taste it then indeed, he (is) from me except whoever takes (in the) hollow (of) his hand" Then they drank from it except a few of them Then when he crossed it he and those who believed with him they said "No strength for us today against Jalut and his troops" Said those who were certain that they (would) meet Allah "How many of a company small overcame a company large by (the) permission (of) Allah And Allah (is) with the patient ones"
2:249.tr: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allah will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allah said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah. And Allah is with the patient."

2:184.ar: أَيَّامٗا مَّعۡدُودَٰتٖۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٖ فَعِدَّةٞ مِّنۡ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَۚ وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُۥ فِدۡيَةٞ طَعَامُ مِسۡكِينٖۖ فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيۡرٗا فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَن تَصُومُواْ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
2:184.wbw: (Fasting for) days numbered So whoever is among you sick or on a journey then a prescribed number of days other And on those who can afford it a ransom (of) feeding a poor And whoever volunteers good then it (is) better for him And to fast (is) better for you if you know
2:184.tr: [Fasting for] a limited number of days. So whoever among you is ill or on a journey [during them] - then an equal number of days [are to be made up]. And upon those who are able [to fast, but with hardship] - a ransom [as substitute] of feeding a poor person [each day]. And whoever volunteers excess - it is better for him. But to fast is best for you, if you only knew.

4:43.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنتُمۡ سُكَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَعۡلَمُواْ مَا تَقُولُونَ وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغۡتَسِلُواْۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرۡضَىٰٓ أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ أَحَدٞ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡغَآئِطِ أَوۡ لَٰمَسۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمۡ تَجِدُواْ مَآءٗ فَتَيَمَّمُواْ صَعِيدٗا طَيِّبٗا فَٱمۡسَحُواْ بِوُجُوهِكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا
4:43.wbw: O you who believe[d]! (Do) not go near the prayer while you (are) intoxicated until you know what you are saying and not (when you are) impure except (when) passing (through) a way until you have bathed And if you are ill or on a journey or came one of you from the toilet or you have touched the women and not you find water then do tayammum (with) earth clean and wipe (with it) your faces and your hands Indeed Allah is Oft-Pardoning Oft-Forgiving
4:43.tr: O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying or in a state of janabah, except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body]. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it]. Indeed, Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.

7:148.ar: وَٱتَّخَذَ قَوۡمُ مُوسَىٰ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِنۡ حُلِيِّهِمۡ عِجۡلٗا جَسَدٗا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۚ أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمۡ وَلَا يَهۡدِيهِمۡ سَبِيلًاۘ ٱتَّخَذُوهُ وَكَانُواْ ظَٰلِمِينَ
7:148.wbw: And took (the) people (of) Musa from after him from their ornaments a calf an image [for] it (had) a lowing sound Did not they see that it (could) not speak to them and not guide them (to) a way? They took it (for worship) and they were wrongdoers
7:148.tr: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers.

9:50.ar: إِن تُصِبۡكَ حَسَنَةٞ تَسُؤۡهُمۡۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡكَ مُصِيبَةٞ يَقُولُواْ قَدۡ أَخَذۡنَآ أَمۡرَنَا مِن قَبۡلُ وَيَتَوَلَّواْ وَّهُمۡ فَرِحُونَ
9:50.wbw: If befalls you good it distresses them but if befalls you a calamity they say "Verily we took our matter before" before" And they turn away while they (are) rejoicing
9:50.tr: If good befalls you, it distresses them; but if disaster strikes you, they say, "We took our matter [in hand] before," and turn away while they are rejoicing.

2:156.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتۡهُم مُّصِيبَةٞ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
2:156.wbw: Those who when strikes them a misfortune they say "Indeed, we belong to Allah and indeed we towards Him will return"
2:156.tr: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return."

20:89.ar: أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلٗا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗا
20:89.wbw: Then did not they see that not it (could) return to them a word and not possess for them any harm and not any benefit?
20:89.tr: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

35:28.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مُخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَۗ إِنَّمَا يَخۡشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡعُلَمَٰٓؤُاْۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
35:28.wbw: And among men and moving creatures and the cattle (are) various [their] colors likewise Only fear Allah among His slaves those who have knowledge Indeed Allah (is) All-Mighty Oft-Forgiving
35:28.tr: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allah, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.

16:13.ar: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
16:13.wbw: And whatever He multiplied for you in the earth (of) varying colors Indeed in that surely (is) a sign for a people who remember
16:13.tr: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.

15:19.ar: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مَّوۡزُونٖ
15:19.wbw: And the earth We have spread it and [We] cast therein firm mountains and [We] caused to grow therein of every thing well-balanced
15:19.tr: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

77:27.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا
77:27.wbw: And We made therein firmly set mountains lofty and We gave you to drink water - sweet?
77:27.tr: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

22:44.ar: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ مَدۡيَنَۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰۖ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
22:44.wbw: And the inhabitants (of) Madyan And Musa was denied And Musa was denied so I granted respite to the disbelievers then I seized them and how was My punishment
22:44.tr: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

25:66.wbw: Indeed it (is) an evil abode and resting place"
25:66.tr: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

7:24.ar: قَالَ ٱهۡبِطُواْ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
7:24.wbw: (Allah) said "Get down some of you to some others (as) enemy And for you in the earth (is) a dwelling place and livelihood for a time"
7:24.tr: [Allah] said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment for a time."

26:124.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26:124.wbw: When said to them their brother Hud "Will not you fear (Allah)?
26:124.tr: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

2:63.ar: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُواْ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٖ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
2:63.wbw: And when We took your covenant and We raised over you the mount "Hold what We have given you with strength and remember what (is) in it perhaps you (would become) righteous"
2:63.tr: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."

5:90.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡخَمۡرُ وَٱلۡمَيۡسِرُ وَٱلۡأَنصَابُ وَٱلۡأَزۡلَٰمُ رِجۡسٞ مِّنۡ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ فَٱجۡتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
5:90.wbw: O you who believe! Verily the intoxicants and [the] games of chance and (sacrifices at) altars and divining arrows (are an) abomination from (the) work (of) the Shaitaan so avoid it so that you may (be) successful
5:90.tr: O you who have believed, indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters [to other than Allah], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may be successful.

29:64.ar: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَهۡوٞ وَلَعِبٞۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ لَهِيَ ٱلۡحَيَوَانُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
29:64.wbw: And not (is) this life (of) the world but amusement and play And indeed the Home (of) the Hereafter - surely it (is) the life if only they know
29:64.tr: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.

62:11.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ تِجَٰرَةً أَوۡ لَهۡوًا ٱنفَضُّوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمٗاۚ قُلۡ مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهۡوِ وَمِنَ ٱلتِّجَٰرَةِۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
62:11.wbw: And when they saw a transaction or a sport they rushed to it and left you standing Say "What (is) with Allah (is) better than the sport and from (any) transaction And Allah (is the) Best (of) the Providers"
62:11.tr: But when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muhammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allah is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allah is the best of providers."

6:137.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ قَتۡلَ أَوۡلَٰدِهِمۡ شُرَكَآؤُهُمۡ لِيُرۡدُوهُمۡ وَلِيَلۡبِسُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دِينَهُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُۖ فَذَرۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَفۡتَرُونَ
6:137.wbw: And likewise made pleasing to many of the polytheists (the) killing (of) their children their partners so that they may ruin them and that they make confusing to them their religion And if (had) willed Allah not (would) they have done so So leave them and what they invent
6:137.tr: And likewise, to many of the polytheists their partners have made [to seem] pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. And if Allah had willed, they would not have done so. So leave them and that which they invent.

55:70.wbw: In them (are) good and beautiful ones
55:70.tr: In them are good and beautiful women -

24:1.ar: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهَا وَفَرَضۡنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
24:1.wbw: A Surah - We (have) sent it down and We (have) made it obligatory and We (have) revealed therein Verses clear so that you may take heed
24:1.tr: [This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.

7:68.ar: أُبَلِّغُكُمۡ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا۠ لَكُمۡ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ
7:68.wbw: I convey to you Messages (of) my Lord and I am to you an adviser - trustworthy
7:68.tr: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.

32:4.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٍۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
32:4.wbw: Allah (is) the One Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between them in six periods Then established Himself on the Throne Not for you besides Him besides Him any protector and not any intercessor Then will not you take heed?
32:4.tr: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?

39:43.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۚ قُلۡ أَوَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
39:43.wbw: Or have they taken besides besides Allah intercessors? Say "Even though they were not possessing anything and not they understand?"
39:43.tr: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

22:20.ar: يُصۡهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمۡ وَٱلۡجُلُودُ
22:20.wbw: Will be melted with it what (is) in their bellies and the skins
22:20.tr: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.

21:77.ar: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٖ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
21:77.wbw: And We helped him from the people who denied Our Signs Indeed they were a people evil so We drowned them all
21:77.tr: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

12:49.ar: ثُمَّ يَأۡتِي مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٞ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعۡصِرُونَ
12:49.wbw: Then will come after after that a year in it will be given abundant rain the people and in it they will press"
12:49.tr: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."

38:32.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
38:32.wbw: And he said "Indeed I [I] preferred (the) love (of) the good for (the) remembrance (of) my Lord" Until they were hidden in the veil;
38:32.tr: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

3:99.ar: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ تَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجٗا وَأَنتُمۡ شُهَدَآءُۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
3:99.wbw: Say "O People (of) the Book! Why (do) you hinder from (the) way (of) Allah (those) who believe[d] seeking (to make) it (seem) crooked while you (are) witnesses? And not Allah (is) unaware of what you do
3:99.tr: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you avert from the way of Allah those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? And Allah is not unaware of what you do."

2:226.ar: لِّلَّذِينَ يُؤۡلُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمۡ تَرَبُّصُ أَرۡبَعَةِ أَشۡهُرٖۖ فَإِن فَآءُو فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
2:226.wbw: For those who swear (off) from their wives (is a) waiting (of) four months then if they return - then indeed Allah (is) Oft- Forgiving Most Merciful
2:226.tr: For those who swear not to have sexual relations with their wives is a waiting time of four months, but if they return [to normal relations] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

19:93.ar: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدٗا
19:93.wbw: Not all who (are) in the heavens and the earth but (will) come (to) the Most Gracious (as) a slave
19:93.tr: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

29:34.ar: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ
29:34.wbw: Indeed we (will) bring down on (the) people (of) this town a punishment from (the) sky because they have been defiantly disobedient"
29:34.tr: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."

61:10.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ تِجَٰرَةٖ تُنجِيكُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
61:10.wbw: O! (you) who! believe! Shall I guide you to a transaction (that) will save you from a punishment painful?
61:10.tr: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?

9:24.ar: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ ءَابَآؤُكُمۡ وَأَبۡنَآؤُكُمۡ وَإِخۡوَٰنُكُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ وَعَشِيرَتُكُمۡ وَأَمۡوَٰلٌ ٱقۡتَرَفۡتُمُوهَا وَتِجَٰرَةٞ تَخۡشَوۡنَ كَسَادَهَا وَمَسَٰكِنُ تَرۡضَوۡنَهَآ أَحَبَّ إِلَيۡكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَجِهَادٖ فِي سَبِيلِهِۦ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
9:24.wbw: Say "If are your fathers and your sons and your brothers and your spouses and your relatives and wealth that you have acquired and the commerce you fear a decline (in) it and the dwellings you delight (in) it (are) more beloved to you than Allah and His Messenger and striving in His way then wait until Allah brings Allah brings His Command And Allah (does) not guide the people the defiantly disobedient"
9:24.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "If your fathers, your sons, your brothers, your wives, your relatives, wealth which you have obtained, commerce wherein you fear decline, and dwellings with which you are pleased are more beloved to you than Allah and His Messenger and jihad in His cause, then wait until Allah executes His command. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people."

5:51.ar: ۞يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ ٱلۡيَهُودَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۘ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمۡ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنۡهُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
5:51.wbw: O you who believe! (Do) not take the Jews and the Christians (as) allies Some of them (are) allies (to) others And whoever takes them as allies among you then indeed, he (is) of them Indeed Allah (does) not guide the people the wrongdoing
5:51.tr: O you who have believed, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies. They are [in fact] allies of one another. And whoever is an ally to them among you - then indeed, he is [one] of them. Indeed, Allah guides not the wrongdoing people.

86:13.wbw: Indeed it (is) surely a Word decisive
86:13.tr: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,

2:16.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ
2:16.wbw: Those (are) the ones who bought [the] astraying for [the] guidance So not profited their commerce and not were they guided-ones
2:16.tr: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

7:61.ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ لَيۡسَ بِي ضَلَٰلَةٞ وَلَٰكِنِّي رَسُولٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
7:61.wbw: He said "O my people! (There is) no in me error but I am a Messenger from (the) Lord (of) the worlds
7:61.tr: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds."

25:44.ar: أَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ أَوۡ يَعۡقِلُونَۚ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا كَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
25:44.wbw: Or do you think that most of them hear or understand? Not they (are) except like cattle Nay they (are) more astray (from the) way
25:44.tr: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.

5:95.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَقۡتُلُواْ ٱلصَّيۡدَ وَأَنتُمۡ حُرُمٞۚ وَمَن قَتَلَهُۥ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدٗا فَجَزَآءٞ مِّثۡلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ ٱلنَّعَمِ يَحۡكُمُ بِهِۦ ذَوَا عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ هَدۡيَۢا بَٰلِغَ ٱلۡكَعۡبَةِ أَوۡ كَفَّٰرَةٞ طَعَامُ مَسَٰكِينَ أَوۡ عَدۡلُ ذَٰلِكَ صِيَامٗا لِّيَذُوقَ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهِۦۗ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا سَلَفَۚ وَمَنۡ عَادَ فَيَنتَقِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۡهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
5:95.wbw: O you who believe! (Do) not kill the game while you (are in) Ihram And whoever killed it among you intentionally then penalty (is) similar (to) what he killed of the cattle judging it two men just among you (as) an offering reaching the Kabah or an expiation feeding needy people or equivalent (of) that (in) fasting that he may taste (the) consequence (of) his deed Pardoned (by) Allah what (has) passed but whoever returned then will take retribution Allah from him And Allah (is) All-Mighty Owner (of) Retribution
5:95.tr: O you who have believed, do not kill game while you are in the state of ihram. And whoever of you kills it intentionally - the penalty is an equivalent from sacrificial animals to what he killed, as judged by two just men among you as an offering [to Allah] delivered to the Ka'bah, or an expiation: the feeding of needy people or the equivalent of that in fasting, that he may taste the consequence of his deed. Allah has pardoned what is past; but whoever returns [to violation], then Allah will take retribution from him. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.

34:43.ar: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالُواْ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٞ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمۡ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمۡ وَقَالُواْ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفۡكٞ مُّفۡتَرٗىۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
34:43.wbw: And when are recited to them Our Verses clear they say "Not (is) this but a man who wishes to hinder you from what used (to) worship your forefathers" And they say "Not (is) this except a lie invented" And said those who disbelieved about the truth when it came to them "Not (is) this except a magic obvious"
34:43.tr: And when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

38:60.ar: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
38:60.wbw: They say "Nay! You - no welcome for you You brought this upon us So wretched is the settlement"
38:60.tr: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

18:84.ar: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ سَبَبٗا
18:84.wbw: Indeed We [We] established [for] him in the earth and We gave him of every thing a means
18:84.tr: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.

40:37.ar: أَسۡبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٖ
40:37.wbw: (The) ways (to) the heavens so I may look at (the) God (of) Musa; and indeed I [I] surely think him (to be) a liar" And thus was made fair-seeming to Firaun (the) evil (of) his deed and he was averted from the way And not (was the) plot (of) Firaun except in ruin
40:37.tr: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.

11:10.ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَٰهُ نَعۡمَآءَ بَعۡدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتُ عَنِّيٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَفَرِحٞ فَخُورٌ
11:10.wbw: But if We give him a taste (of) favor after hardship (has) touched him surely he will say "Have gone the evils from me Indeed he (is) exultant (and) boastful
11:10.tr: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -

10:21.ar: وَإِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُمۡ إِذَا لَهُم مَّكۡرٞ فِيٓ ءَايَاتِنَاۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَسۡرَعُ مَكۡرًاۚ إِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكۡتُبُونَ مَا تَمۡكُرُونَ
10:21.wbw: And when We let [the] mankind taste We let [the] mankind taste mercy after after adversity has touched them behold! They have a plot against Our Verses Say "Allah (is) more swift (in) planning" Indeed Our Messengers write down what you plot
10:21.tr: And when We give the people a taste of mercy after adversity has touched them, at once they conspire against Our verses. Say, "Allah is swifter in strategy." Indeed, Our messengers record that which you conspire

19:51.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصٗا وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا
19:51.wbw: And mention in the Book Musa Indeed he was chosen and was a Messenger a Prophet
19:51.tr: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

23:83.ar: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
23:83.wbw: Verily we have been promised [we] and our forefathers this before before not (is) this but (the) tales (of) the former (people)"
23:83.tr: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

68:15.ar: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
68:15.wbw: When are recited to him Our Verses he says "Stories (of) the former (people)"
68:15.tr: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

30:27.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهۡوَنُ عَلَيۡهِۚ وَلَهُ ٱلۡمَثَلُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
30:27.wbw: And He (is) the One Who originates the creation then repeats it and it (is) easier for Him And for Him (is) the description the highest in the heavens and the earth And He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise
30:27.tr: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

87:1.wbw: Glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most High
87:1.tr: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

37:8.ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
37:8.wbw: Not they may listen to the assembly [the] exalted are pelted from every side
37:8.tr: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,

34:33.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتُضۡعِفُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ بَلۡ مَكۡرُ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذۡ تَأۡمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكۡفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجۡعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادٗاۚ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَۚ وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلَ فِيٓ أَعۡنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ هَلۡ يُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
34:33.wbw: And will say those who were oppressed to those who were arrogant "Nay (it was) a plot (by) night and (by) day when you were ordering us that we disbelieve in Allah and we set up for Him equals" But they will conceal the regret when they see the punishment And We will put shackles on (the) necks (of) those who disbelieved Will they be recompensed except (for) what they used to do?
34:33.tr: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allah and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?

36:8.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلٗا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
36:8.wbw: Indeed We [We] have placed on their necks iron collars and they (are up)to the chins so they (are with) heads aloft
36:8.tr: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

76:4.ar: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا
76:4.wbw: Indeed We [We] have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a Blazing Fire
76:4.tr: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

33:12.ar: وَإِذۡ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورٗا
33:12.wbw: And when said the hypocrites and those in their hearts (was) a disease "Not Allah promised us Allah promised us and His messenger except delusion"
33:12.tr: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

4:120.ar: يَعِدُهُمۡ وَيُمَنِّيهِمۡۖ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
4:120.wbw: He promises them and arouses desires in them and not promises them the Shaitaan - except deception
4:120.tr: Satan promises them and arouses desire in them. But Satan does not promise them except delusion.

72:9.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا
72:9.wbw: And that we used (to) sit there in positions for hearing but (he) who listens now will find for him a flaming fire waiting
72:9.tr: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

35:9.ar: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابٗا فَسُقۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ مَّيِّتٖ فَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
35:9.wbw: And Allah (is) the One Who sends the winds so that they raise (the) clouds and We drive them to a land dead and We revive therewith the earth after its death Thus (will be) the Resurrection
35:9.tr: And it is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.

10:14.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لِنَنظُرَ كَيۡفَ تَعۡمَلُونَ
10:14.wbw: Then We made you successors in the earth after them after them so that We may see how you do
10:14.tr: Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do.

2:30.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي جَاعِلٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ خَلِيفَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَجۡعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفۡسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَۖ قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
2:30.wbw: And when said your Lord to the angels "Indeed, I (am) going to place in the earth a vicegerent they said "Will You place in it (one) who will spread corruption in it and will shed [the] blood[s] while we [we] glorify (You) with Your praises and we sanctify [to] You He said "Indeed, I [I] know what (do) not you know"
2:30.tr: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

31:24.ar: نُمَتِّعُهُمۡ قَلِيلٗا ثُمَّ نَضۡطَرُّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ
31:24.wbw: We grant them enjoyment (for) a little then We will force them to a punishment severe
31:24.tr: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.

3:159.ar: فَبِمَا رَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلۡقَلۡبِ لَٱنفَضُّواْ مِنۡ حَوۡلِكَۖ فَٱعۡفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمۡ وَشَاوِرۡهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمۡتَ فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
3:159.wbw: So because (of) Mercy from Allah you dealt gently with them And if you had been rude (and) harsh (at) [the] heart surely they (would have) dispersed from around you Then pardon [from] them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter Then when you have decided then put trust on Allah Indeed Allah loves the ones who put trust (in Him)
3:159.tr: So by mercy from Allah, [O Muhammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely [upon Him].

4:21.ar: وَكَيۡفَ تَأۡخُذُونَهُۥ وَقَدۡ أَفۡضَىٰ بَعۡضُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ وَأَخَذۡنَ مِنكُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظٗا
4:21.wbw: And how could you take it when surely has gone - one of you to another and they have taken from you covenant strong?
4:21.tr: And how could you take it while you have gone in unto each other and they have taken from you a solemn covenant?

15:71.ar: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيٓ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
15:71.wbw: He said "These (are) my daughters if you would be doers"
15:71.tr: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

80:11.tr: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;

4:126.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّحِيطٗا
4:126.wbw: And for Allah (is) what (is) in the heavens and what (is) in the earth and is Allah of every thing All-Encompassing
4:126.tr: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allah, of all things, encompassing.

85:20.wbw: But Allah from behind them encompasses
85:20.tr: While Allah encompasses them from behind.

5:68.ar: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَسۡتُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُواْ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡۗ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنۡهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغۡيَٰنٗا وَكُفۡرٗاۖ فَلَا تَأۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
5:68.wbw: Say "O People (of) the Book! You are not on anything until you stand fast (by) the Taurat and the Injeel and what has been revealed to you from your Lord And surely increase many of them what has been revealed to you from your Lord (in) rebellion and disbelief So (do) not grieve over the people the disbelieving
5:68.tr: Say, "O People of the Scripture, you are [standing] on nothing until you uphold [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to you from your Lord." And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief. So do not grieve over the disbelieving people.

18:80.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَٰنٗا وَكُفۡرٗا
18:80.wbw: And as for the boy his parents were his parents were believers and we feared that he would overburden them (by) transgression and disbelief
18:80.tr: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.

2:189.ar: ۞يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡأَهِلَّةِۖ قُلۡ هِيَ مَوَٰقِيتُ لِلنَّاسِ وَٱلۡحَجِّۗ وَلَيۡسَ ٱلۡبِرُّ بِأَن تَأۡتُواْ ٱلۡبُيُوتَ مِن ظُهُورِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡبِرَّ مَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰۗ وَأۡتُواْ ٱلۡبُيُوتَ مِنۡ أَبۡوَٰبِهَاۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
2:189.wbw: They ask you about the new moons Say "They (are) indicators of periods for the people and (for) the Hajj And it is not [the] righteousness that you come (to) the houses from their backs [and] but [the] righteous (is one) who fears (Allah) And come (to) the houses from their doors And fear Allah so that you may (be) successful
2:189.tr: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the new moons. Say, "They are measurements of time for the people and for Hajj." And it is not righteousness to enter houses from the back, but righteousness is [in] one who fears Allah. And enter houses from their doors. And fear Allah that you may succeed.

58:3.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
58:3.wbw: And those who pronounce zihar [from] (to) their wives then go back on what they said then freeing (of) a slave before before [that] they touch each other That you are admonished to it And Allah of what you do (is) All-Aware
58:3.tr: And those who pronounce thihar from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

47:4.ar: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرۡبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثۡخَنتُمُوهُمۡ فَشُدُّواْ ٱلۡوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنَّۢا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلۡحَرۡبُ أَوۡزَارَهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبۡلُوَاْ بَعۡضَكُم بِبَعۡضٖۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:4.wbw: So when you meet those who disbelieve then strike the necks until when you have subdued them then bind firmly the bond then either a favor afterwards or ransom until lays down the war its burdens That And if Allah had willed Allah had willed surely, He could have taken retribution from them but to test some of you with others And those who are killed in (the) way of Allah (the) way of Allah then never He will cause to be lost their deeds
47:4.tr: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.

19:52.ar: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيّٗا
19:52.wbw: And We called him from (the) side (of) the Mount the right and brought him near (for) conversation
19:52.tr: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].

25:56.wbw: And not We sent you except (as) a bearer of glad tidings and a warner
25:56.tr: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

4:165.ar: رُّسُلٗا مُّبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ حُجَّةُۢ بَعۡدَ ٱلرُّسُلِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمٗا
4:165.wbw: Messengers bearers of glad tidings and warners so that not there is for the mankind against Allah any argument after the Messengers And is Allah All-Mighty All-Wise
4:165.tr: [We sent] messengers as bringers of good tidings and warners so that mankind will have no argument against Allah after the messengers. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.

35:24.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗاۚ وَإِن مِّنۡ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٞ
35:24.wbw: Indeed We [We] have sent you with the truth (as) a bearer of glad tidings and (as) a warner And not (was) any nation but had passed within it a warner
35:24.tr: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.

41:4.ar: بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا فَأَعۡرَضَ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ
