28:25.tr: Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness. She said, "Indeed, my father invites you that he may reward you for having watered for us." So when he came to him and related to him the story, he said, "Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people."

7:55.ar: ٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخُفۡيَةًۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ
7:55.wbw: Call upon your Lord humbly and privately Indeed He (does) not love the transgressors
7:55.tr: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.

2:57.ar: وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰۖ كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
2:57.wbw: And We shaded [over] you (with) [the] clouds and We sent down to you [the] manna and [the] quails "Eat from (the) good things that We have provided you" And not they wronged Us but they were (to) themselves doing wrong
2:57.tr: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.

26:49.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
26:49.wbw: He said "You believed in him before [that] I gave permission to you Indeed he (is) surely your chief who has taught you the magic so surely soon you will know I will surely cut off your hands and your feet of opposite sides and I will surely crucify you all"
26:49.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

9:60.ar: ۞إِنَّمَا ٱلصَّدَقَٰتُ لِلۡفُقَرَآءِ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ عَلَيۡهَا وَٱلۡمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَفِي ٱلرِّقَابِ وَٱلۡغَٰرِمِينَ وَفِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۖ فَرِيضَةٗ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ
9:60.wbw: Only the charities (are) for the poor and the needy and those who collect them and the ones inclined their hearts and in the (freeing of) the necks and for those in debt and in (the) way (of) Allah and the wayfarer and the wayfarer an obligation from Allah And Allah (is) All-Knowing All-Wise
9:60.tr: Zakah expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy and for those employed to collect [zakah] and for bringing hearts together [for Islam] and for freeing captives [or slaves] and for those in debt and for the cause of Allah and for the [stranded] traveler - an obligation [imposed] by Allah. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

21:5.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَضۡغَٰثُ أَحۡلَٰمِۭ بَلِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٞ فَلۡيَأۡتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٖ كَمَآ أُرۡسِلَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
21:5.wbw: Nay they say "Muddled dreams; nay he (has) invented it; nay he (is) a poet So let him bring us a sign like what was sent (to) the former"
21:5.tr: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

24:59.ar: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلۡأَطۡفَٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلۡحُلُمَ فَلۡيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُواْ كَمَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ
24:59.wbw: And when reach the children among you the puberty then let them ask permission as asked permission those who (were) before them (were) before them Thus Allah makes clear Allah makes clear for you His Verses And Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise
24:59.tr: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.

29:13.ar: وَلَيَحۡمِلُنَّ أَثۡقَالَهُمۡ وَأَثۡقَالٗا مَّعَ أَثۡقَالِهِمۡۖ وَلَيُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
29:13.wbw: But surely they will carry their burdens and burdens with their burdens and surely they will be questioned (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection about what they used (to) invent
29:13.tr: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.

50:14.ar: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖۚ كُلّٞ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
50:14.wbw: And (the) companions (of) the wood and (the) people (of) Tubba All denied the Messengers so was fulfilled My Threat
50:14.tr: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

12:39.ar: يَٰصَٰحِبَيِ ٱلسِّجۡنِ ءَأَرۡبَابٞ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيۡرٌ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
12:39.wbw: O my two companions (of) the prison! Are lords separate better or Allah the One the Irresistible?
12:39.tr: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allah, the One, the Prevailing?

2:283.ar: ۞وَإِن كُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٖ وَلَمۡ تَجِدُواْ كَاتِبٗا فَرِهَٰنٞ مَّقۡبُوضَةٞۖ فَإِنۡ أَمِنَ بَعۡضُكُم بَعۡضٗا فَلۡيُؤَدِّ ٱلَّذِي ٱؤۡتُمِنَ أَمَٰنَتَهُۥ وَلۡيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥۗ وَلَا تَكۡتُمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَۚ وَمَن يَكۡتُمۡهَا فَإِنَّهُۥٓ ءَاثِمٞ قَلۡبُهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمٞ
2:283.wbw: And if you are on a journey and not you find a scribe then pledge in hand Then if entrusts one of you (to) another then let discharge the one who is entrusted his trust And let him fear Allah his Lord And (do) not conceal the evidence And whoever conceals it then indeed he (is) sinful - his heart And Allah of what you do (is) All-Knower
2:283.tr: And if you are on a journey and cannot find a scribe, then a security deposit [should be] taken. And if one of you entrusts another, then let him who is entrusted discharge his trust [faithfully] and let him fear Allah, his Lord. And do not conceal testimony, for whoever conceals it - his heart is indeed sinful, and Allah is Knowing of what you do.

22:21.wbw: And for them (are) hooked rods of iron
22:21.tr: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.

3:77.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشۡتَرُونَ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلًا أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَٰقَ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
3:77.wbw: Indeed those who exchange (the) Covenant (of) Allah and their oaths (for) a price little those no share for them in the Hereafter and not will speak to them Allah and not look at them (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection and not purify them and for them (is) a punishment painful
3:77.tr: Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allah will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment.

4:156.ar: وَبِكُفۡرِهِمۡ وَقَوۡلِهِمۡ عَلَىٰ مَرۡيَمَ بُهۡتَٰنًا عَظِيمٗا
4:156.wbw: And for their disbelief and their saying against Maryam a slander great
4:156.tr: And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander,

23:53.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرٗاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ
23:53.wbw: But they cut off their affair (of unity) between them (into) sects each faction in what they have rejoicing
23:53.tr: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

16:22.ar: إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٞ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
16:22.wbw: Your god (is) God One But those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter their hearts refuse and they (are) arrogant
16:22.tr: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.

41:34.ar: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُۚ ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٞ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٞ
41:34.wbw: And not are equal the good (deed) and the evil (deed) Repel by (that) which [it] (is) better; then behold! One who between you and between him (was) enmity as if he (was) a friend intimate
41:34.tr: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.

31:7.ar: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا كَأَنَّ فِيٓ أُذُنَيۡهِ وَقۡرٗاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
31:7.wbw: And when are recited to him Our Verses he turns away arrogantly as if not he (had) heard them as if in his ears (is) deafness So give him tidings of a punishment painful
31:7.tr: And when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

39:16.ar: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
39:16.wbw: For them from above them coverings of the Fire and from below them coverings (With) that threatens Allah [with it] His slaves "O My slaves! So fear Me"
39:16.tr: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

26:224.wbw: And the poets - follow them the deviators
26:224.tr: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

7:151.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدۡخِلۡنَا فِي رَحۡمَتِكَۖ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
7:151.wbw: He said "O my Lord! Forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your Mercy for You (are) the Most Merciful (of) the merciful"
7:151.tr: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."

23:118.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
23:118.wbw: And say "My Lord! Forgive and have mercy and You (are the) Best (of) those who show mercy
23:118.tr: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

39:46.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
39:46.wbw: Say "O Allah! Creator (of) the heavens and the earth Knower (of) the unseen and the witnessed You will judge between Your slaves in what they used (to) therein differ"
39:46.tr: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

57:18.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلۡمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقۡرَضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمۡ وَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٞ كَرِيمٞ
57:18.wbw: Indeed the men who give charity and the women who give charity and who lend (to) Allah a loan goodly it will be multiplied for them and for them (is) a reward noble
57:18.tr: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.

68:42.ar: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقٖ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
68:42.wbw: (The) Day will be uncovered from the shin and they will be called to prostrate but not they will be able
68:42.tr: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,

50:40.wbw: And of the night glorify Him and after the prostration
50:40.tr: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.

2:65.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعۡتَدَوۡاْ مِنكُمۡ فِي ٱلسَّبۡتِ فَقُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ كُونُواْ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ
2:65.wbw: And indeed you knew those who transgressed among you in the (matter of) Sabbath So We said to them "Be apes despised"
2:65.tr: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."

15:17.wbw: And We have protected it from every devil accursed
15:17.tr: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]

3:134.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلۡكَٰظِمِينَ ٱلۡغَيۡظَ وَٱلۡعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
3:134.wbw: Those who spend in [the] ease and (in) the hardship and those who restrain the anger and those who pardon [from] the people - and Allah loves the good-doers
3:134.tr: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good;

67:8.ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ
67:8.wbw: It almost bursts with rage Every time is thrown therein a group will ask them its keepers "Did not come to you a warner?"
67:8.tr: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

13:35.ar: ۞مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٞ وَظِلُّهَاۚ تِلۡكَ عُقۡبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْۚ وَّعُقۡبَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ
13:35.wbw: The example of Paradise which (is) promised (to) the righteous flows from underneath it the rivers Its food (is) everlasting and its shade This (is the) end of those who (are) righteous and (the) end (of) the disbelievers (is) the Fire
13:35.tr: The example of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire.

13:24.ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُم بِمَا صَبَرۡتُمۡۚ فَنِعۡمَ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ
13:24.wbw: (Saying) Peace (be) upon you for what you patiently endured And excellent (is) the final attainment (of) the Home"
13:24.tr: "Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."

53:4.wbw: Not it (is) except a revelation revealed
53:4.tr: It is not but a revelation revealed,

12:111.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمۡ عِبۡرَةٞ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثٗا يُفۡتَرَىٰ وَلَٰكِن تَصۡدِيقَ ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
12:111.wbw: Verily (there) is in their stories a lesson for men (of) understanding Not (it) is a narration invented but a confirmation (of that) which (was) before it (was) before it and a detailed explanation (of) all things and a guidance and mercy for a people who believe
12:111.tr: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

25:8.ar: أَوۡ يُلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ كَنزٌ أَوۡ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٞ يَأۡكُلُ مِنۡهَاۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلٗا مَّسۡحُورًا
25:8.wbw: Or is delivered to him a treasure or is for him a garden he may eat from it And say the wrongdoers "Not you follow but a man bewitched"
25:8.tr: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

21:88.ar: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
21:88.wbw: So We responded to him and We saved him from the distress And thus We save the believers
21:88.tr: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

14:30.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۗ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
14:30.wbw: And they set up to Allah equals so that they mislead from His Path Say "Enjoy but indeed your destination (is) to the Fire"
14:30.tr: And they have attributed to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."

41:9.ar: ۞قُلۡ أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
41:9.wbw: Say "Do you indeed [surely] disbelieve in the One Who created the earth in two periods and you set up with Him rivals? That (is the) Lord (of) the worlds"
41:9.tr: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

17:88.ar: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجۡتَمَعَتِ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأۡتُواْ بِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ لَا يَأۡتُونَ بِمِثۡلِهِۦ وَلَوۡ كَانَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٖ ظَهِيرٗا
17:88.wbw: Say "If gathered the mankind and the jinn to [that] bring the like (of) this Quran not they (could) bring the like of it even if were some of them to some others assistants"
17:88.tr: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."

28:17.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنۡ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرٗا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
28:17.wbw: He said "My Lord! Because You have favored [on] me so not I will be a supporter (of) the criminals"
28:17.tr: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."

7:205.ar: وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفۡسِكَ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخِيفَةٗ وَدُونَ ٱلۡجَهۡرِ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡغَٰفِلِينَ
7:205.wbw: And remember your Lord in yourself humbly and (in) fear and without the loudness of [the] words in the mornings and (in) the evenings And (do) not be among the heedless
7:205.tr: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.

4:22.ar: وَلَا تَنكِحُواْ مَا نَكَحَ ءَابَآؤُكُم مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ إِلَّا مَا قَدۡ سَلَفَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةٗ وَمَقۡتٗا وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًا
4:22.wbw: And (do) not marry whom married your fathers of the women except what has passed before indeed it was an immorality and hateful and (an) evil way
4:22.tr: And do not marry those [women] whom your fathers married, except what has already occurred. Indeed, it was an immorality and hateful [to Allah] and was evil as a way.

61:3.ar: كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُواْ مَا لَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
61:3.wbw: Great is hatred with Allah that you say what not? you do?
61:3.tr: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

24:61.ar: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ إِخۡوَٰنِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَعۡمَٰمِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ عَمَّٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخۡوَٰلِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ خَٰلَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكۡتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوۡ صَدِيقِكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ جَمِيعًا أَوۡ أَشۡتَاتٗاۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلۡتُم بُيُوتٗا فَسَلِّمُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ تَحِيَّةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَٰرَكَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
24:61.wbw: Not is on the blind any blame and not on the lame any blame and not on the sick any blame and not on yourselves that you eat from your houses or houses (of) your fathers or houses (of) your mothers or houses (of) your brothers or houses (of) your sisters or houses (of) your paternal uncles or houses (of) your paternal aunts or houses (of) your maternal uncles or houses (of) your maternal aunts or what you possess its keys or your friend Not is on you any blame that you eat together or separately But when you enter houses then greet [on] yourselves a greeting from from Allah blessed (and) good Thus Allah makes clear Allah makes clear for you the Verses so that you may understand
24:61.tr: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allah, blessed and good. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.

30:25.ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ دَعۡوَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمۡ تَخۡرُجُونَ
30:25.wbw: And among His Signs (is) that stands the heavens and the earth by His Command Then when He calls you (with) a call from the earth behold! You will come forth
30:25.tr: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth remain by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

3:9.ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوۡمٖ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
3:9.wbw: Our Lord! Indeed You will gather [the] mankind on a Day (there is) no doubt in it Indeed Allah (does) not break the Promise"
3:9.tr: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise."

34:30.ar: قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوۡمٖ لَّا تَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ عَنۡهُ سَاعَةٗ وَلَا تَسۡتَقۡدِمُونَ
34:30.wbw: Say "For you (is the) appointment (of) a Day not you can postpone [of] it (for) an hour and not (can) you precede (it)"
34:30.tr: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."

37:48.wbw: And with them (will be) companions of modest gaze (will be) companions of modest gaze (having) beautiful eyes
37:48.tr: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,

38:19.wbw: And the birds assembled all with him repeatedly turning
38:19.tr: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

54:15.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
54:15.wbw: And certainly We left it (as) a Sign so is (there) any who will receive admonition?
54:15.tr: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

2:69.ar: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوۡنُهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ صَفۡرَآءُ فَاقِعٞ لَّوۡنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّٰظِرِينَ
2:69.wbw: They said "Pray for us (to) your Lord to make clear to us what (is) its color" He said "Indeed He says [Indeed] it is a cow yellow bright (in) its color pleasing (to) those who see (it)
2:69.tr: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.' "

51:53.ar: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
51:53.wbw: Have they transmitted it to them? Have they transmitted it to them? Nay they (are) a people transgressing
51:53.tr: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

76:16.wbw: Crystal-clear of silver They will determine its measure
76:16.tr: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

76:17.ar: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
76:17.wbw: And they will be given to drink therein a cup - is its mixture (of) Zanjabil
76:17.tr: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

69:10.ar: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةٗ رَّابِيَةً
69:10.wbw: And they disobeyed (the) Messenger (of) their Lord so He seized them (with) a seizure exceeding
69:10.tr: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

4:100.ar: ۞وَمَن يُهَاجِرۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يَجِدۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُرَٰغَمٗا كَثِيرٗا وَسَعَةٗۚ وَمَن يَخۡرُجۡ مِنۢ بَيۡتِهِۦ مُهَاجِرًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ يُدۡرِكۡهُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَقَدۡ وَقَعَ أَجۡرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
4:100.wbw: And whoever emigrates in (the) way (of) Allah will find in the earth place(s) of refuge many and abundance And whoever leaves from his home (as) an emigrant to Allah and His Messenger then overtakes him [the] death then certainly (became) incumbent his reward on Allah And is Allah Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
4:100.tr: And whoever emigrates for the cause of Allah will find on the earth many [alternative] locations and abundance. And whoever leaves his home as an emigrant to Allah and His Messenger and then death overtakes him - his reward has already become incumbent upon Allah. And Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

5:91.ar: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلۡبَغۡضَآءَ فِي ٱلۡخَمۡرِ وَٱلۡمَيۡسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ
5:91.wbw: Only intends the Shaitaan to cause between you [the] enmity and [the] hatred through intoxicants and gambling and hinders you from (the) remembrance (of) Allah and from the prayer So will you (be) the ones who abstain?
5:91.tr: Satan only wants to cause between you animosity and hatred through intoxicants and gambling and to avert you from the remembrance of Allah and from prayer. So will you not desist?

11:71.ar: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٞ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهَا بِإِسۡحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسۡحَٰقَ يَعۡقُوبَ
11:71.wbw: And his wife (was) standing and she laughed Then We gave her glad tidings of Ishaq and after and after Isaac (of) Yaqub
11:71.tr: And his Wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.

71:10.ar: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا
71:10.wbw: Then I said "Ask forgiveness (from) your Lord Indeed He is Oft-Forgiving
71:10.tr: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

24:55.ar: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسۡتَخۡلِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمَا ٱسۡتَخۡلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱرۡتَضَىٰ لَهُمۡ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَوۡفِهِمۡ أَمۡنٗاۚ يَعۡبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ بِي شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
24:55.wbw: Allah (has) promised Allah (has) promised those who believe among you and do righteous deeds surely He will grant them succession in the earth as He gave succession to those who (were) before them (were) before them and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He has approved for them and surely He will change for them after after their fear security (for) they worship Me not they associate with Me anything But whoever disbelieved after that then those [they] (are) the defiantly disobedient
24:55.tr: Allah has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.

32:12.ar: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ نَاكِسُواْ رُءُوسِهِمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ رَبَّنَآ أَبۡصَرۡنَا وَسَمِعۡنَا فَٱرۡجِعۡنَا نَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
32:12.wbw: And if you (could) see when the criminals (will) hang their heads before their Lord "Our Lord we have seen and we have heard so return us we will do righteous (deeds) Indeed we (are now) certain"
32:12.tr: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."

13:15.ar: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ طَوۡعٗا وَكَرۡهٗا وَظِلَٰلُهُم بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ۩
13:15.wbw: And to Allah prostrates whoever (is) in the heavens and the earth willingly or unwillingly and (so do) their shadows in the mornings and in the afternoons
13:15.tr: And to Allah prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.

12:99.ar: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَبَوَيۡهِ وَقَالَ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مِصۡرَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ
12:99.wbw: Then when they entered upon Yusuf he took to himself his parents and said "Enter Egypt if Allah wills Allah wills safe"
12:99.tr: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself and said, "Enter Egypt, Allah willing, safe [and secure]."

17:36.ar: وَلَا تَقۡفُ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٌۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡبَصَرَ وَٱلۡفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنۡهُ مَسۡـُٔولٗا
17:36.wbw: And (do) not pursue what not you have of it any knowledge Indeed the hearing and the sight and the heart all those will be [about it] questioned
17:36.tr: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.

2:19.ar: أَوۡ كَصَيِّبٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٞ وَرَعۡدٞ وَبَرۡقٞ يَجۡعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
2:19.wbw: Or like a rainstorm from the sky in it (are) darkness[es] and thunder and lightning They put their fingers in their ears from the thunderclaps (in) fear (of) [the] death And Allah (is) [the One Who] encompasses the disbelievers
2:19.tr: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.

21:1.ar: ٱقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مُّعۡرِضُونَ
21:1.wbw: (Has) approached for [the] mankind their account while they (are) in heedlessness turning away
21:1.tr: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

7:176.ar: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ بِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُۚ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡكَلۡبِ إِن تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ يَلۡهَثۡ أَوۡ تَتۡرُكۡهُ يَلۡهَثۚ ذَّٰلِكَ مَثَلُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَاۚ فَٱقۡصُصِ ٱلۡقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
7:176.wbw: And if We willed surely We (could) have raised him with these [and] but he adhered to the earth and followed his (vain) desires So his example (is) like (the) example (of) the dog if you attack [on] him he lolls out his tongue or if you leave him he lolls out his tongue That (is the) example (of) the people who denied [in] Our Signs So relate the story so that they may reflect
7:176.tr: And if We had willed, we could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought.

23:35.ar: أَيَعِدُكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ إِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخۡرَجُونَ
23:35.wbw: Does he promise you - that you when you are dead and you become dust and bones that you (will be) brought forth?
23:35.tr: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

12:19.ar: وَجَآءَتۡ سَيَّارَةٞ فَأَرۡسَلُواْ وَارِدَهُمۡ فَأَدۡلَىٰ دَلۡوَهُۥۖ قَالَ يَٰبُشۡرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَٰمٞۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَٰعَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ
12:19.wbw: And there came a caravan and they sent their water drawer then he let down his bucket He said "O good news! This (is) a boy" And they hid him (as) a merchandise And Allah (is) All- Knower of what they do
12:19.tr: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and Allah was knowing of what they did.

18:18.ar: وَتَحۡسَبُهُمۡ أَيۡقَاظٗا وَهُمۡ رُقُودٞۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمۡ ذَاتَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِۖ وَكَلۡبُهُم بَٰسِطٞ ذِرَاعَيۡهِ بِٱلۡوَصِيدِۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَوَلَّيۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِرَارٗا وَلَمُلِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ رُعۡبٗا
18:18.wbw: And you (would) think them awake while they (were) asleep And We turned them to the right and to the left while their dog stretched his two forelegs at the entrance If you had looked at them you (would) have surely turned back from them (in) flight and surely you would have been filled by them (with) terror
18:18.tr: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.

72:21.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا
72:21.wbw: Say "Indeed I (do) not possess for you any harm and not right path"
72:21.tr: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

18:10.ar: إِذۡ أَوَى ٱلۡفِتۡيَةُ إِلَى ٱلۡكَهۡفِ فَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةٗ وَهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا رَشَدٗا
18:10.wbw: When retreated the youths to the cave and they said "Our Lord! Grant us from Yourself Mercy and facilitate for us [from] our affair (in the) right way"
18:10.tr: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

6:59.ar: ۞وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَا يَعۡلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۚ وَمَا تَسۡقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعۡلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا رَطۡبٖ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ
6:59.wbw: And with Him (are the) keys (of) the unseen no (one) knows them except Him And He knows what (is) in the land and in the sea And not falls of any leaf but He knows it And not a grain in the darkness[es] (of) the earth and not moist and not dry but (is) in a Record Clear
6:59.tr: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record.

56:54.wbw: And drink over it [from] the scalding water
56:54.tr: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

11:117.ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُونَ
11:117.wbw: And not would your Lord destroy the cities unjustly while its people (were) reformers
11:117.tr: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
